SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Alameda';

SELECT f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Educational Option Type` = 'Continuation Education'
ORDER BY eligible_free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3

SELECT s.Zip
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Charter School (Y/N)` = 1
  AND f.`District Name` = 'Fresno County Office of Education'

SELECT s.MailStreet
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."FRPM Count (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT s.Phone
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
  AND f."Charter Funding Type" = 'Directly funded'
  AND s.OpenDate > '2000-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(T1.cds)
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.AvgScrMath > 400
  AND T2.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT s.School AS School_Name
FROM satscores st
INNER JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 500
  AND s.Magnet = 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores t ON s.CDSCode = t.cds
ORDER BY t.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.NumTstTakr
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f."FRPM Count (K-12)" = (
    SELECT MAX(f2."FRPM Count (K-12)")
    FROM frpm f2
);
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM satscores s INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode WHERE s.AvgScrMath > 560 AND sc.FundingType = 'Directly funded'

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
ORDER BY s.AvgScrRead DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT f.CDSCode
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Enrollment (K-12)" + f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" > 500;

SELECT MAX(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS highest_eligible_free_rate
FROM satscores s
JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
JOIN frpm f ON sc.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.NumTstTakr > 0
  AND s.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / s.NumTstTakr > 0.3;

SELECT sc.Phone
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / s.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 3

SELECT sc.School, sc.NCESSchool, fr."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS Enrollment
FROM frpm fr
INNER JOIN schools sc ON fr.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY fr."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT s.dname AS District, AVG(s.AvgScrRead) AS AvgReadingScore
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.StatusType = 'Active'
GROUP BY s.dname
ORDER BY AvgReadingScore DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode)
FROM schools sc
INNER JOIN satscores st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE sc.County = 'Alameda'
  AND sc.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND st.NumTstTakr < 100;

SELECT T1.CharterNum, T2.sname, T2.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.CharterNum IS NOT NULL AND T2.AvgScrWrite > 499
ORDER BY T2.AvgScrWrite DESC

SELECT COUNT(T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T1.County = 'Fresno'
  AND T1.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T2.NumTstTakr <= 250

SELECT s.Phone
FROM satscores t
INNER JOIN schools s ON t.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY t.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.CDSCode)
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."County Name" = 'Amador'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12';

SELECT COUNT(f.CDSCode)
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" > 500
  AND f."FRPM Count (K-12)" < 700
SELECT sname FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa' AND NumTstTakr = (SELECT MAX(NumTstTakr) FROM satscores WHERE cname = 'Contra Costa')

SELECT s.School, s.Street
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 30

SELECT s.sname
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE CAST(f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` AS REAL) / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1
  AND s.NumGE1500 >= 1;

SELECT sc.School, sc.FundingType
FROM schools AS sc
INNER JOIN satscores AS sa ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sc.City = 'Riverside'
GROUP BY sc.School, sc.FundingType
HAVING SUM(sa.AvgScrMath) / COUNT(sa.sname) > 400;

SELECT s.School, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Monterey'
  AND f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)" > 800
  AND s."SOCType" = 'High Schools (Public)';

SELECT sc.sname AS School_Name, sc.AvgScrWrite AS Average_Writing_Score, s.Phone AS Communication_Number
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN satscores sc ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR (s.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL AND s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01');

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  AND (f."Enrollment (K-12)" - f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") > (
      SELECT AVG(f2."Enrollment (K-12)" - f2."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)")
      FROM frpm f2
      INNER JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode
      WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded'
  );

SELECT s.OpenDate
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, SUM(f."Enrollment (K-12)") AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
GROUP BY s.City
ORDER BY TotalEnrollment ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT frpm."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 1.0 / frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" AS eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
ORDER BY frpm."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9;
SELECT `FRPM Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` FROM frpm WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE SOC = 66) ORDER BY `FRPM Count (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT sa.sname AS School_Name, sc.Website
FROM frpm fr
INNER JOIN schools sc ON fr.CDSCode = sc.CDSCode
INNER JOIN satscores sa ON sc.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE fr."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" BETWEEN 1900 AND 2000;

SELECT f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" * 1.0 / f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)" AS free_rate
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Gibson')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Kacey' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Gibson');

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE f."Charter School (Y/N)" = 1
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AdmFName1 || ' ' || s.AdmLName1 AS Admin1_FullName,
       s.AdmFName2 || ' ' || s.AdmLName2 AS Admin2_FullName,
       s.AdmFName3 || ' ' || s.AdmLName3 AS Admin3_FullName
FROM satscores st
INNER JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State
FROM satscores AS st
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE st.NumTstTakr > 0 AND st.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / st.NumTstTakr ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Website
FROM satscores st
INNER JOIN schools s ON st.cds = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND st.NumTstTakr BETWEEN 2000 AND 3000;

SELECT AVG(s.NumTstTakr)
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.County = 'Fresno'
  AND sc.OpenDate LIKE '%/1980';
SELECT T2.Phone FROM satscores AS T1 INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode WHERE T1.dname = 'Fresno Unified' ORDER BY T1.AvgScrRead ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT sname
FROM (
    SELECT sa.sname,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sa.cname ORDER BY sa.AvgScrRead DESC) AS rnk
    FROM satscores sa
    INNER JOIN schools sc ON sa.cds = sc.CDSCode
    WHERE sc.Virtual = 'F'
) t
WHERE rnk <= 5;

SELECT sc.EILName
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrMath, sc.County
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY (s.AvgScrMath + s.AvgScrRead + s.AvgScrWrite) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.AvgScrWrite, sc.City
FROM satscores AS s
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sch.School AS sname, s.AvgScrWrite
FROM schools AS sch
INNER JOIN satscores AS s ON sch.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE sch.AdmFName1 = 'Ricci' AND sch.AdmLName1 = 'Ulrich';

SELECT s.School
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.DOC = 31
ORDER BY f."Enrollment (K-12)" DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) / 12.0 AS monthly_avg_opened
FROM schools
WHERE County = 'Alameda'
  AND DOC = '52'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', OpenDate) = '1980';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT u.CDSCode) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.CDSCode) AS ratio
FROM schools u
INNER JOIN schools e
    ON u.County = e.County
   AND u.StatusType = e.StatusType
WHERE u.County = 'Orange'
  AND u.StatusType = 'Merged'
  AND u.DOC = '54'
  AND e.DOC = '52';

SELECT s.County, s.School, s.ClosedDate
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS closed_count
    FROM schools
    WHERE StatusType = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY County
    ORDER BY closed_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS top_county ON top_county.County = s.County
WHERE s.StatusType = 'Closed';

SELECT s.sname AS School_Name, sc.MailStreet AS Postal_Street
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY s.AvgScrMath DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6;

SELECT sc.MailStreet, st.sname
FROM satscores AS st
INNER JOIN schools AS sc ON st.cds = sc.CDSCode
ORDER BY st.AvgScrRead ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT sc.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS sc
INNER JOIN satscores AS st ON sc.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE (st.AvgScrRead + st.AvgScrMath + st.AvgScrWrite) >= 1500
  AND sc.MailCity = 'Lakeport';

SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS total_test_takers
FROM satscores s
INNER JOIN schools sc ON s.cds = sc.CDSCode
WHERE sc.MailCity = 'Fresno';

SELECT s.School, s.MailZip
FROM schools s
WHERE (s.AdmFName1 = 'Avetik' AND s.AdmLName1 = 'Atoian')
   OR (s.AdmFName2 = 'Avetik' AND s.AdmLName2 = 'Atoian')
   OR (s.AdmFName3 = 'Avetik' AND s.AdmLName3 = 'Atoian');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_schools
FROM schools s
WHERE s.MailState = 'CA'
  AND s.StatusType = 'Active'
  AND s.City = 'San Joaquin';

SELECT T2.Phone, T2.Ext
FROM satscores AS T1
INNER JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.AvgScrWrite DESC
LIMIT 1 OFFSET 332

SELECT Website FROM schools WHERE CDSCode IN (SELECT CDSCode FROM schools WHERE (AdmFName1 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName1 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName2 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Mike' AND AdmLName3 = 'Larson') OR (AdmFName1 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName1 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName2 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName2 = 'Alvarez') OR (AdmFName3 = 'Dante' AND AdmLName3 = 'Alvarez'))

SELECT s.Website
FROM schools s
WHERE s.Virtual = 'P'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.County = 'San Joaquin'

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.City = 'Hickman'
  AND s.Charter = 1
  AND s.DOC = 52;

SELECT COUNT(s.CDSCode)
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles'
  AND s.Charter = 0
  AND f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100 / f."Enrollment (K-12)" < 0.18
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM schools WHERE MailCity = 'Hickman' AND CharterNum = '00D4'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(s.FundingType) AS ratio_percentage
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.County = 'Santa Clara' AND s.Charter = 'Y' AND s.FundingType IS NOT NULL

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.CDSCode)
FROM schools AS T1
LEFT JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.FundingType = 'Directly Funded'
  AND T1.County = 'Stanislaus'
  AND T1.OpenDate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2005-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_closures
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.DOCType = 'Community College District'
  AND s.ClosedDate LIKE '1989%'
  AND s.City = 'San Francisco';

SELECT s.County
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.SOC = 11
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', s.ClosedDate) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989
GROUP BY s.County
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM schools s 
WHERE s.County = 'Alpine' 
  AND s.SOCType = 'District Community Day School' 
  AND s.StatusType IN ('Active', 'Closed');

SELECT f."District Code"
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.City = 'Fresno' AND s.Magnet = 0;

SELECT SUM(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)") AS TotalEnrollment
FROM frpm AS f
INNER JOIN schools AS s
    ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.EdOpsCode = 'SSS'
  AND s.City = 'Fremont'
  AND f."Academic Year" = '2014-2015';

SELECT f."FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)"
FROM frpm f
INNER JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE s.MailStreet = 'PO Box 1040'
  AND f."Educational Option Type" = 'Youth Authority School';

SELECT frpm."Low Grade"
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.EdOpsCode = 'SPECON'
  AND schools.NCESDist = '0613360';

SELECT schools."School", schools."EILName" FROM schools WHERE schools."CDSCode" IN (SELECT frpm."CDSCode" FROM frpm WHERE frpm."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Breakfast Provision 2' AND frpm."County Code" = '37');

SELECT s.City
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.EILCode = 'HS'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = '2'
  AND f."Low Grade" = '9'
  AND f."High Grade" = '12'
  AND s.County = 'Merced';

SELECT s.School, f.`FRPM Count (Ages 5-17)` * 100.0 / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (Ages 5-17)` FROM schools s INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.GSserved = 'K-9' AND s.County = 'Los Angeles'

SELECT s.GSserved
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.City = 'Adelanto'
GROUP BY s.GSserved
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT sc.County, COUNT(sc.CDSCode) AS num_schools
FROM schools sc
WHERE sc.County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara')
  AND sc.Virtual = 'F'
GROUP BY sc.County
ORDER BY num_schools DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.`School Type`, T1.`School`, T1.`Latitude`
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN frpm AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode
ORDER BY T1.Latitude DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT s.City, f."Low Grade", s.School
FROM schools AS s
INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY s.Latitude ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.GSoffered
FROM schools s
ORDER BY ABS(s.Longitude) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.City, COUNT(*) 
FROM schools AS T2 
INNER JOIN frpm AS T1 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.CDSCode 
WHERE T2.Magnet = 1 
  AND T2.GSoffered = 'K-8' 
  AND T1.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' 
GROUP BY T2.City 
ORDER BY T2.City

SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.District, COUNT(*) AS NameCount
FROM schools AS s
GROUP BY s.AdmFName1, s.District
ORDER BY NameCount DESC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT f."District Code" AS district_code, (f."Free Meal Count (K-12)" * 100.0) / f."Enrollment (K-12)" AS percent_eligible_free
FROM schools s
INNER JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE s."AdmFName1" = 'Alusine' OR s."AdmFName2" = 'Alusine' OR s."AdmFName3" = 'Alusine';

SELECT s.AdmEmail1
FROM schools AS s
WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino'
  AND s.District = 'San Bernardino City Unified'
  AND s.SOC = 62
  AND s.DOC = 54
  AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31';

SELECT sc.sname AS School_Name, s.AdmEmail1 AS Admin_Email
FROM satscores sc
INNER JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode
ORDER BY sc.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CASE WHEN u1.Reputation > u2.Reputation THEN u1.DisplayName ELSE u2.DisplayName END AS HigherReputationUser
FROM users u1
INNER JOIN users u2 ON u2.DisplayName = 'Jarrod Dixon'
WHERE u1.DisplayName = 'Harlan';
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM users u WHERE strftime('%Y', u.CreationDate) = '2011'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE LastAccessDate > '2014-09-01';
SELECT u.DisplayName FROM users u ORDER BY u.Views DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE UpVotes > 100 AND DownVotes > 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE Views > 10 AND CAST(strftime('%Y', CreationDate) AS INTEGER) > 2013;

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Title
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
ORDER BY p.ViewCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
ORDER BY p.FavoriteCount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(p.CommentCount) AS TotalComments
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT MAX(p.AnswerCount) AS AnswerCount
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.LastEditorUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Examples for teaching: Correlation does not mean causation';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS root_post_count
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND p.ParentId IS NULL;

SELECT DISTINCT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.ClosedDate IS NOT NULL;

SELECT COUNT(p.Id)
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.Age > 65 AND p.Score >= 20;

SELECT u.Location
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Title = 'Eliciting priors from experts';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags t
INNER JOIN posts p ON t.ExcerptPostId = p.Id
WHERE t.TagName = 'bayesian';

SELECT p.Body
FROM tags AS t
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON p.Id = t.ExcerptPostId
ORDER BY t.Count DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(b.Id) AS BadgeCount
FROM users u
INNER JOIN badges b ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT b.Name
FROM badges b
INNER JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(b.Id)
FROM badges b
INNER JOIN users u ON b.UserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie'
  AND strftime('%Y', b.Date) = '2011';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM users u
INNER JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
GROUP BY u.Id, u.DisplayName
ORDER BY COUNT(b.Id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(p.Score) AS AverageScore
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'csgillespie';

SELECT COUNT(b.Id) * 1.0 / COUNT(u.DisplayName) AS average_badges
FROM users u
LEFT JOIN badges b ON u.Id = b.UserId
WHERE u.Views > 200;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN u.Age > 65 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(p.Id) AS percentage
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Score > 5;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM votes AS v INNER JOIN users AS u ON v.UserId = u.Id WHERE v.UserId = 58 AND v.CreationDate LIKE '2010-07-19%'

SELECT vc.CreationDate
FROM (SELECT CreationDate, COUNT(Id) AS cnt
      FROM votes
      GROUP BY CreationDate) AS vc
JOIN (SELECT MAX(cnt) AS maxcnt
      FROM (SELECT COUNT(Id) AS cnt
            FROM votes
            GROUP BY CreationDate) AS cc) AS mx
  ON vc.cnt = mx.maxcnt;
SELECT COUNT(b.Id) FROM badges AS b WHERE b.Name = 'Revival'

SELECT p.Title
FROM comments c
INNER JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
ORDER BY c.Score DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(c.Id) AS CommentCount
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ViewCount = 1910;

SELECT p.FavoriteCount
FROM comments c
INNER JOIN posts p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 3025
  AND c.CreationDate = '2014/4/23 20:29:39.0'

SELECT c.Text
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN comments c ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE p.ParentId = 107829 AND p.CommentCount = 1;

SELECT p.ClosedDate
FROM comments AS c
INNER JOIN posts AS p ON c.PostId = p.Id
WHERE c.UserId = 23853
  AND c.CreationDate = '2013-07-12 09:08:18.0';

SELECT u.Reputation
FROM posts p
INNER JOIN users u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE p.Id = '65041';

SELECT COUNT(p.Id) AS PostCount
FROM users u
INNER JOIN posts p ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Tiago Pasqualini';

SELECT u.DisplayName
FROM votes v
INNER JOIN users u ON v.UserId = u.Id
WHERE v.Id = 6347;

WHERE c.Segment = 'SME'
  AND substr(y.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
GROUP BY y.Date
ORDER BY SUM(y.Consumption) DESC
LIMIT 1

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth AS y
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, y.CustomerID
),
segment_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
avg_segment AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_2013 AS t
    INNER JOIN segment_min AS m
        ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_SME_LAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS diff_KAM_SME
FROM avg_segment;

WITH pct AS (
  SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013,
         SUM(CASE WHEN substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012
  FROM customers c
  INNER JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    AND substr(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS PercentageIncrease,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 DESC) AS rk_desc,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 ASC) AS rk_asc
  FROM pct
)
SELECT Segment, PercentageIncrease
FROM ranked
WHERE rk_desc = 1 OR rk_asc = 1
ORDER BY PercentageIncrease DESC;

WITH cust_totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           c.CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND CAST(ym.Date AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, c.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM cust_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT ct.Segment,
           SUM(ct.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT ct.CustomerID) AS annual_avg
    FROM cust_totals ct
    JOIN seg_min sm ON sm.Segment = ct.Segment
                   AND ct.total_consumption = sm.min_consumption
    GROUP BY ct.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') -
        (SELECT annual_avg FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE status IN ('A', 'C')
      AND date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_a AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
balance_b AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (balance_a.balance - balance_b.balance) * 100.0 / balance_b.balance AS increase_rate
FROM balance_a
CROSS JOIN balance_b;

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT cz.Segment, cz.total_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 cz
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cz.Segment = m.Segment AND cz.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match

    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
    UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match
) AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON m.player_id = p.player_api_id
JOIN Country AS c ON m.country_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.name
HAVING AVG(p.weight) = (
    SELECT MAX(avg_w)
    FROM (
        SELECT AVG(p2.weight) AS avg_w
        FROM (
            SELECT country_id, home_player_1 AS player_id FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_2 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_3 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_4 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_5 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_6 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_7 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_8 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_9 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_10 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, home_player_11 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_1 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_2 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_3 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_4 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_5 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_6 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_7 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_8 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_9 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_10 FROM Match
            UNION ALL SELECT country_id, away_player_11 FROM Match

WITH czk2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS seg, c.CustomerID AS cid, y.Consumption AS cons
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
),
mins AS (
    SELECT seg, MIN(cons) AS min_cons
    FROM czk2013
    GROUP BY seg
),
avgs AS (
    SELECT z.seg AS seg, SUM(z.cons) * 1.0 / COUNT(z.cid) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk2013 z
    JOIN mins m ON z.seg = m.seg AND z.cons = m.min_cons
    GROUP BY z.seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'LAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'KAM') - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avgs WHERE seg = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH cons AS (
  SELECT c.Segment,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2012' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2012,
         SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(y.Date,1,4) = '2013' THEN y.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS consumption_2013
  FROM yearmonth y
  JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = y.CustomerID
  WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
  SELECT Segment,
         (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) * 100.0 / consumption_2013 AS percentage
  FROM cons
)
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, percentage FROM pct ORDER BY percentage DESC LIMIT 1)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (SELECT Segment, percentage FROM pct ORDER BY percentage ASC LIMIT 1);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id) FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', P.birthday) < '1986' AND PA.defensive_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT P.player_name, MAX(PA.crossing) AS max_crossing FROM Player AS P JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name IN ('Alexis', 'Ariel Borysiuk', 'Arouna Kone') GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY max_crossing DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT PA.heading_accuracy
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
ORDER BY PA.date DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.player_api_id) FROM Player p JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id WHERE p.height > 180 AND pa.volleys > 70;

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.volleys > 70 AND PA.dribbling > 70;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN Country ON Match.country_id = Country.id WHERE Country.name = 'Belgium' AND Match.season = '2008/2009';

SELECT pa.long_passing
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
ORDER BY p.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match INNER JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE League.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND SUBSTR(Match.date, 1, 7) = '2009-04'

SELECT L.name
FROM League AS L
JOIN Match AS M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2008/2009'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY COUNT(M.id) DESC
LIMIT 1
SELECT SUM(T2.overall_rating) / COUNT(T2.id) FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.birthday) < '1986'

SELECT (
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes PA
   JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
   WHERE P.player_name = 'Ariel Borysiuk'
   ORDER BY PA.date DESC LIMIT 1)
  -
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes PA
   JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
   WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   ORDER BY PA.date DESC LIMIT 1)
) * 100.0 /
  (SELECT PA.overall_rating
   FROM Player_Attributes PA
   JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
   WHERE P.player_name = 'Paulin Puel'
   ORDER BY PA.date DESC LIMIT 1);
SELECT AVG(TA.buildUpPlaySpeed) FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Heart of Midlothian'
SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Pietro Marino'
SELECT SUM(T1.crossing) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Aaron Lennox'

SELECT chanceCreationPassing, chanceCreationPassingClass
FROM Team_Attributes
JOIN Team ON Team_Attributes.team_api_id = Team.team_api_id
WHERE Team.team_long_name = 'Ajax'
ORDER BY chanceCreationPassing DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT DISTINCT PA.preferred_foot FROM Player_Attributes PA JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Abdou Diallo'
SELECT MAX(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Dorlan Pabon'
SELECT AVG(m.away_team_goal) FROM Match m JOIN Team t ON m.away_team_api_id = t.team_api_id JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id WHERE t.team_long_name = 'Parma' AND c.name = 'Italy';

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.date LIKE '2016-06-23%' AND PA.overall_rating = 77
ORDER BY P.birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT PA.overall_rating FROM Player_Attributes AS PA JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id WHERE P.player_name = 'Aaron Mooy' AND PA.date LIKE '2016-02-04%'
SELECT T2.potential FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Francesco Parravicini' AND T2.date = '2010-08-30 00:00:00'

SELECT PA.attacking_work_rate
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE P.player_name = 'Francesco Migliore'
  AND PA.date LIKE '2015-05-01%';
SELECT T2.defensive_work_rate FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T1.player_name = 'Kevin Berigaud' AND T2.date = '2013-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT date FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant') AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE player_api_id = (SELECT player_api_id FROM Player WHERE player_name = 'Kevin Constant')) ORDER BY date LIMIT 1;

SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team_Attributes TA
JOIN Team T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Willem II' AND TA.date = '2012-02-22';
SELECT T.buildUpPlayDribblingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T INNER JOIN Team AS C ON T.team_api_id = C.team_api_id WHERE C.team_short_name = 'LEI' AND T.date = '2015-09-10 00:00:00'
SELECT buildUpPlayPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes WHERE team_api_id = (SELECT team_api_id FROM Team WHERE team_long_name = 'FC Lorient') AND date LIKE '2010-02-22%';

SELECT T_Attributes.chanceCreationPassingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS T_Attributes JOIN Team AS T ON T_Attributes.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'PEC Zwolle' AND T_Attributes.date = '2013-09-20 00:00:00'
SELECT TA.chanceCreationCrossingClass FROM Team_Attributes AS TA JOIN Team AS T ON TA.team_api_id = T.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hull City' AND TA.date = '2010-02-22 00:00:00'

SELECT TA.defenceAggressionClass
FROM Team_Attributes AS TA
JOIN Team AS T ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'Hannover 96'
  AND TA.date LIKE '2015-09-10%';

SELECT AVG(T1.overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.player_name = 'Marko Arnautovic' AND substr(T1.date, 1, 10) BETWEEN '2007-02-22' AND '2016-04-21'

SELECT (
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
    -
    (SELECT pa.overall_rating
     FROM Player_Attributes pa
     JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
     WHERE p.player_name = 'Jordan Bowery' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%')
) * 100.0 /
(
    SELECT pa.overall_rating
    FROM Player_Attributes pa
    JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
    WHERE p.player_name = 'Landon Donovan' AND pa.date LIKE '2013-07-12%'
) AS percentage;
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height = (SELECT MAX(height) FROM Player);
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player ORDER BY weight DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE (julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - julianday(birthday)) / 365.25 > 34;

SELECT SUM(m.home_team_goal)
FROM Match AS m
JOIN Player AS p ON p.player_name = 'Aaron Lennon'
WHERE m.home_player_1 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_2 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_3 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_4 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_5 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_6 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_7 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_8 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_9 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_10 = p.player_api_id
   OR m.home_player_11 = p.player_api_id;

SELECT SUM(M.away_team_goal)
FROM Match M
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id IN (M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
WHERE P.player_name IN ('Daan Smith', 'Filipe Ferreira');

SELECT SUM(home_team_goal)
FROM Match
WHERE id IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.id
    FROM Match m
    JOIN Player p
      ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
                             m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
                             m.home_player_11)
    WHERE (strftime('%Y', datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, 'localtime')) - strftime('%Y', datetime(p.birthday))) < 31
);
SELECT T2.player_name FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T1.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name FROM Player P JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id WHERE PA.potential = (SELECT MAX(potential) FROM Player_Attributes)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.attacking_work_rate = 'high'

SELECT T2.player_name FROM Player AS T2 INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS T1 ON T2.player_api_id = T1.player_api_id WHERE T1.finishing = 1 ORDER BY julianday(datetime(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,'localtime')) - julianday(datetime(T2.birthday)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
JOIN Country c ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country AS C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5, m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11)
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT T.team_long_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';
SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe'

SELECT AVG(P.height)
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match AS M ON PA.id = M.id
JOIN Country AS C ON M.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy'
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990'
SELECT (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 6) - (SELECT jumping FROM Player_Attributes WHERE id = 23) AS jumping_difference
SELECT player_api_id FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'right' GROUP BY player_api_id ORDER BY MIN(potential) ASC LIMIT 5;
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left' AND crossing = (SELECT MAX(crossing) FROM Player_Attributes WHERE preferred_foot = 'left');
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN strength > 80 AND stamina > 80 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) FROM Player_Attributes
SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';
SELECT m.home_team_goal, m.away_team_goal FROM Match m INNER JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id WHERE l.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League' AND m.date LIKE '2008-09-24%'
SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration FROM Player_Attributes pa JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';
SELECT TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass FROM Team AS T JOIN Team_Attributes AS TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' AND League.name = 'Italy Serie A'
SELECT MAX(T1.home_team_goal) FROM Match AS T1 JOIN League AS T2 ON T1.league_id = T2.id WHERE T2.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie'
SELECT T1.finishing, T1.curve FROM Player_Attributes AS T1 INNER JOIN Player AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id WHERE T2.weight = ( SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player )
SELECT League.name FROM Match JOIN League ON Match.league_id = League.id WHERE Match.season = '2015/2016' GROUP BY League.name ORDER BY COUNT(Match.id) DESC LIMIT 4

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Match M ON T.team_api_id = M.away_team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);
SELECT T1.player_name FROM Player AS T1 JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id ORDER BY T2.overall_rating DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE account.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU' AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague';
SELECT CASE WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995' ELSE '1996' END AS higher_unemployment_year FROM district
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) FROM district d JOIN client c ON d.district_id = c.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND d.A11 > 6000 AND d.A11 < 10000;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM client JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id WHERE client.gender = 'M' AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' AND district.A11 > 8000

SELECT T1.account_id, (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - T4.A11 FROM account AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id JOIN client AS T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T3.gender = 'F' ORDER BY T3.birth_date ASC, T4.A11 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT T1.account_id
FROM account T1
JOIN disp T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id
JOIN client T3 ON T2.client_id = T3.client_id
JOIN district T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id
WHERE T3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND T4.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' AND d.type = 'Owner'

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT account.account_id FROM account JOIN loan ON account.account_id = loan.account_id WHERE loan.status = 'C' AND loan.date LIKE '1997%' AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE' ORDER BY loan.amount ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE duration > 12 AND amount = (SELECT MAX(amount) FROM loan WHERE duration > 12) AND account_id IN (SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE date LIKE '93%')

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 INNER JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id INNER JOIN district AS T3 ON T1.district_id = T3.district_id WHERE T1.gender = 'F' AND T1.birth_date < '1950-01-01' AND T3.A2 = 'Sokolov'
SELECT account_id FROM trans WHERE date = (SELECT MIN(date) FROM trans WHERE substr(date, 1, 4) = '1995')
SELECT DISTINCT T1.account_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN trans AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T1.date < '1997-01-01' AND T2.balance > 3000
SELECT d.client_id FROM disp d JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id WHERE c.issued LIKE '1994-03-03%'
SELECT account.date FROM account JOIN trans ON account.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 840 AND trans.date = '1998-10-14';
SELECT T1.district_id FROM account AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.account_id = T2.account_id WHERE T2.date = '1994-08-25' AND T2.status = 'A'

SELECT MAX(t.amount)
FROM trans t
JOIN disp d ON t.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN card c ON d.disp_id = c.disp_id
WHERE c.issued = '1996-10-21';

SELECT c.gender FROM client c JOIN account a ON c.district_id = a.district_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT amount
FROM trans
WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM loan ORDER BY amount DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY date
LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.client_id) FROM client AS T1 JOIN disp AS T2 ON T1.client_id = T2.client_id JOIN account AS T3 ON T2.account_id = T3.account_id JOIN district AS T4 ON T3.district_id = T4.district_id WHERE T4.A2 = 'Jesenik' AND T1.gender = 'F'
SELECT disp.disp_id FROM disp JOIN trans ON disp.account_id = trans.account_id WHERE trans.amount = 5100 AND trans.date = '1998-09-02'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Litomerice' AND account.date LIKE '96%';

SELECT d.A2
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND c.birth_date = '1976-01-29'

SELECT client.birth_date
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN disp ON account.account_id = disp.account_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE loan.amount = 98832 AND loan.date = '1996-01-03';

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A3 = 'Prague'
ORDER BY a.date ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client
WHERE district_id = (
    SELECT district_id
    FROM district
    WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
    ORDER BY A4 DESC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH target AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
b1 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
b2 AS (
    SELECT t.balance
    FROM trans t
    JOIN target ON t.account_id = target.account_id
    WHERE t.date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY t.trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT (b2.balance - b1.balance) * 100.0 / b1.balance
FROM b1, b2;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) FROM loan
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'C' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM loan WHERE amount < 100000;

SELECT a.account_id, d.A2, d.A3
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', a.date) = '1993'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT a.account_id, a.frequency
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district t ON c.district_id = t.district_id
WHERE t.A3 = 'east Bohemia'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND substr(a.date, 1, 2) IN ('95', '96', '97', '98', '99', '00');
SELECT account.account_id, account.date FROM account JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE district.A2 = 'Prachatice'
SELECT district.A2, district.A3 FROM loan JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id WHERE loan.loan_id = 4990

SELECT l.account_id, d.A2 AS district, d.A3 AS region
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.amount > 300000;

SELECT loan.loan_id, district.A3, district.A11
FROM loan
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE loan.duration = 60

SELECT DISTINCT d.A2 AS district, ((d.A13 - d.A12) * 100.0 / d.A12) AS unemployment_rate_increment
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'D';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN d.A2 = 'Decin' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM account a JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE a.date LIKE '1993%';
SELECT account_id FROM account WHERE frequency = 'POPLATEK MESICNE'

SELECT d.A2, COUNT(*) AS num_female_account_holders
FROM client c
JOIN disp ON c.client_id = disp.client_id AND disp.type = 'OWNER'
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2
ORDER BY num_female_account_holders DESC
LIMIT 9;

SELECT district.A2, SUM(trans.amount) AS total_withdrawals
FROM trans
JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE trans.type = 'VYDAJ' AND trans.date LIKE '1996-01%'
GROUP BY district.A2
ORDER BY total_withdrawals DESC
LIMIT 10;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id)
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district dt ON c.district_id = dt.district_id
WHERE dt.A3 = 'South Bohemia'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM card cd
    JOIN disp d2 ON cd.disp_id = d2.disp_id

WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT c.segment,
           k.customer_id,
           SUM(k.paid)         AS total_paid,
           SUM(k.consumption)  AS total_consumption
    FROM consumption k
    JOIN customer  c ON c.customer_id = k.customer_id
    WHERE k.date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.segment, k.customer_id
),
min_paid AS (                      -- lowest amount paid per segment
    SELECT segment, MIN(total_paid) AS mp
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY segment
),
lowest AS (                        -- all customer(s) at that minimum
    SELECT y.segment,
           y.total_consumption
    FROM yearly y
    JOIN min_paid m
      ON y.segment = m.segment AND y.total_paid = m.mp
),
avg_seg AS (                       -- annual average consumption
    SELECT segment,
           SUM(total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY segment
)

What Orange County does have are incorporated **towns**:
- **Orange** (the county seat)
- **Gordonsville**
- **Locust Grove**

## Most Common Sign of SLE

**Arthritis/arthralgia (joint pain and inflammation)** is the most common clinical manifestation of Systemic Lupus Erythematosus (SLE), occurring in approximately **90% of patients** at some point during the disease course.

**Key details:**
- Typically affects small joints of the hands, wrists, and knees
- Usually symmetric and often migratory
- Characteristically **non-erosive** (unlike rheumatoid arthritis), though joint deformities (Jaccoud's arthropathy) can occur in some patients

**Honorable mentions for comparison:**

| Manifestation | Approximate Frequency |
|---------------|----------------------|
| Arthritis/arthralgia | ~90% |
| Fatigue (most common *symptom*) | ~80–90% |
| Fever | ~50–60% |
| Malar ("butterfly") rash | ~30–50% |
| Renal involvement (lupus nephritis) | ~40–50% |
| Photosensitivity | ~30–40% |

*Note:* If strictly distinguishing **symptoms** (subjective complaints) from **signs** (objective findings), fatigue is the most common *symptom*, while arthritis remains the most common *sign*.

with lower than normal range:** Count all records where PLT < 100
   - `Count_low = SUM(PLT < 100)`

2. **Count patients with higher than normal range:** Count all records where PLT > 400
   - `Count_high = SUM(PLT > 400)`

3. **Compare the two groups:**
   - `Difference = Count_low − Count_high`

**Interpreting the result:**
- If the difference is **positive**, more patients have platelet levels lower than normal (PLT < 100) than higher than normal (PLT > 400)
- If the difference is **negative**, more patients have platelet levels higher than normal
- If the difference is **zero**, the two groups are equal in size

Note that patients with PLT exactly equal to 100 or 400 are considered abnormal but fall within the boundary values specified in the definition (PLT ≤ 100 or PLT ≥ 400), so they wouldn't be counted in either sub-group.

The specific compound wasn't provided, so here's how to determine the bond type in any carbon-containing compound using SMILES notation:

## Carbon's Bonding Options

Carbon is **tetravalent** (forms 4 bonds), so depending on the compound, it can form:

| Bond Type | SMILES Symbol | Example | Compound Class |
|-----------|---------------|---------|----------------|
| Single bond | `-` | `C-C` (ethane) | Alkanes |
| Double bond | `=` | `C=C` (ethene) | Alkenes |
| Triple bond | `#` | `C#C` (ethyne) | Alkynes |

## Important Note on Lowercase 'c'

The hint specifies element = **'c'** (lowercase), which in SMILES notation indicates an **aromatic carbon**. In aromatic compounds like:

- `c1ccccc1` (benzene)

The bonds between aromatic carbons are **delocalized/aromatic bonds** — they are neither purely single nor purely double, but a resonance hybrid (often written as `:` in SMILES, or represented as alternating `-` and `=` in Kekulé form).

## How to Identify the Bond Type

Check the symbol **between** two carbon atoms in the SMILES string:

- `cc` or `cc` with no symbol between lowercase atoms → **aromatic bond**
- `C-C` → **single bond**
- `C=C` → **double bond**
- `C#C` → **triple bond**

WITH totals AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment, ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS TotalConsumption
    FROM customers AS c
    JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013'
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(TotalConsumption) AS MinConsumption
    FROM totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
averages AS (
    SELECT t.Segment AS Segment, SUM(t.TotalConsumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(t.CustomerID) AS AnnualAvg
    FROM totals AS t
    JOIN lowest AS l ON l.Segment = t.Segment AND l.MinConsumption = t.TotalConsumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS SME_minus_LAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS LAM_minus_KAM,
    (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT AnnualAvg FROM averages WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS KAM_minus_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth AS ym
    JOIN customers AS c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM seg
     ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cons2013, 0) DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase_segment,
    (SELECT Segment FROM seg
     ORDER BY (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / NULLIF(cons2013, 0) ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase_segment;

    FROM Team_Attributes
    WHERE buildUpPlayDribblingClass = 'Normal'
      AND date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND date <= '2014-01-31 00:00:00'

  AND TA.date >= '2014-01-01 00:00:00'

JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L."T-CHO" < 250;
SELECT T1.ID, T2.GLU FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU < 180 AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1991';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX, P.Birthday DESC;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS AGE
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND (STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50 AND T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;
SELECT p.ID, p.SEX FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.HGB > 10 AND l.HGB < 17 ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT Patient.ID, SUBTRACT(year(current_timestamp), year(Patient.Birthday)) AS age FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.HCT >= 52 GROUP BY Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday HAVING COUNT(Laboratory.ID) > 2
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS result FROM Laboratory WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984' AND (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) < 50 AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN T.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS T ON P.ID = T.ID
WHERE CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 55
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) > '1992' AND T2.PT < 14
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND T2.APTT < 45
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.APTT > 45 AND e.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01' AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450)
SELECT DISTINCT T1.`Diagnosis` FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.`ID` = T2.`ID` WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30
SELECT DISTINCT `Patient`.`ID` FROM `Patient` JOIN `Laboratory` ON `Patient`.`ID` = `Laboratory`.`ID` WHERE `Laboratory`.`U-PRO` > 0 AND `Laboratory`.`U-PRO` < 30 AND `Patient`.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG >= 2000
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGG > 900 AND l.IGG < 2000 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.IGA = (SELECT MAX(L2.IGA) FROM Laboratory L2 WHERE L2.IGA BETWEEN 80 AND 500);
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.IGA > 80 AND l.IGA < 500 AND YEAR(p.`First Date`) >= 1990;
SELECT P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.IGM <= 40 OR L.IGM >= 400 GROUP BY P.Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(P.Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.CRP = '+' AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE >= 1.5 AND YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(T1.Birthday) < 70
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T3.RA IN ('-', '+-') AND T2.KCT = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE YEAR(T1.Birthday) >= 1985 AND T2.RA IN ('-', '+-')

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20
  AND (YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 60;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Examination ON Laboratory.ID = Examination.ID WHERE Laboratory.RF < 20 AND Examination.Thrombosis = '0';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory L JOIN Examination E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L.`C3` > 35 AND E.`ANA Pattern` = 'P'
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Examination AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.HCT <= 29 OR T2.HCT >= 52 ORDER BY T3.`aCL IgA` DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE E.Thrombosis = 2 AND L.C4 > 10
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.RNP IN ('-', '+-') AND p.Admission = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RNP NOT IN ('-', '+-') ORDER BY T1.Birthday DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SM IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT P.ID FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.SM NOT IN ('negative', '0') GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday ORDER BY P.Birthday DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01'
  AND L.SC170 IN ('negative', '0');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.SC170 IN ('negative', '0')
  AND p.SEX = 'F'
  AND e.Symptoms IS NULL;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.SSA IN('-', '+-') AND YEAR(Patient.`First Date`) < 2000
SELECT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SSA NOT IN ('negative', '0') ORDER BY T1.`First Date` LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND e.Diagnosis = 'SLE';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID WHERE L.SSB IN ('negative', '0') AND E.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CENTROMEA IN ('-', '+-') AND l.SSB IN ('-', '+-') AND p.SEX = 'M';
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.DNA >= 8;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Laboratory.ID) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.DNA < 8 AND Patient.Description IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.IGG > 900 AND T2.IGG < 2000 AND T1.Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE' THEN 1 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60;
SELECT COUNT(Patient.ID) FROM Patient INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.GOT < 60
SELECT MAX(Patient.Birthday) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT >= 60
SELECT T1.Birthday FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT < 60 ORDER BY T2.GPT DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60 AND Patient.SEX = 'M';
SELECT MIN(P.`First Date`) FROM Patient AS P JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.LDH < 500 GROUP BY P.ID ORDER BY MAX(L.LDH) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT MAX(T1.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T1 JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.LDH >= 500 AND T2."First Date" = (SELECT MAX("First Date") FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH >= 500))
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Patient AS t1 JOIN Laboratory AS t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE CAST(t2.ALP AS INTEGER) >= 300 AND t1.Admission = '+'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.ALP < 300
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TP < 6.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS' AND T2.TP > 6.0 AND T2.TP < 8.5
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB = (SELECT MAX(ALB) FROM Laboratory WHERE ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5) AND ALB > 3.5 AND ALB < 5.5
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.ALB > 3.5 AND L.ALB < 5.5 AND L.TP BETWEEN 6.0 AND 8.5

SELECT e."aCL IgG", e."aCL IgM", e."aCL IgA"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA > 6.50
ORDER BY l.UA DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT MAX(T1.ANA) FROM Examination AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.CRE < 1.5

SELECT e.ID FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE l.CRE < 1.5 AND e.`aCL IgA` = (SELECT MAX(e2.`aCL IgA`) FROM Examination e2 JOIN Laboratory l2 ON e2.ID = l2.ID WHERE l2.CRE < 1.5);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` LIKE '%P%';

SELECT Examination.ANA
FROM Examination
JOIN Laboratory ON Examination.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`T-BIL` < 2.0
ORDER BY Laboratory.`T-BIL` DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT L.ID) FROM Laboratory AS L JOIN Examination AS E ON L.ID = E.ID WHERE L.`T-CHO` >= 250 AND E.KCT = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` < 250
  AND e.`ANA Pattern` = 'P';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.TG < 200 AND e.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
SELECT P.Diagnosis FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID WHERE L.TG = (SELECT MAX(TG) FROM Laboratory WHERE TG < 200);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID JOIN Laboratory AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 0 AND T3.CPK < 250
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) FROM Laboratory l JOIN Examination e ON l.ID = e.ID WHERE l.CPK < 250 AND (e.KCT = '+' OR e.RVVT = '+' OR e.LAC = '+')
SELECT MIN(T1.Birthday) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GLU > 180
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.ID) FROM Laboratory t1 JOIN Examination t2 ON t1.ID = t2.ID WHERE t1.GLU < 180 AND t2.Thrombosis = 0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Admission = '+' AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE' AND l.WBC BETWEEN 3.5 AND 9.0
SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID FROM Patient JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID WHERE (Laboratory.RBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.RBC >= 6.0) AND Patient.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.PLT > 100 AND T2.PLT < 400 AND T1.Diagnosis IS NOT NULL
SELECT Laboratory.PLT FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Laboratory.PLT > 100 AND Laboratory.PLT < 400 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'MCTD'
SELECT AVG(T1.PT) FROM Laboratory AS T1 INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.PT < 14
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) FROM Examination e JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID WHERE e.Thrombosis IN (1, 2) AND l.PT < 14;
SELECT bond_type FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type HAVING COUNT(bond_type) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(bond_type) AS cnt FROM bond GROUP BY bond_type) AS t)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '-' AND a.element = 'cl';
SELECT AVG(atom.element = 'o') FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN bond.bond_type = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM molecule
INNER JOIN atom ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
INNER JOIN connected ON connected.atom_id = atom.atom_id
INNER JOIN bond ON bond.bond_id = connected.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'na' AND m.label = '-'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND m.label = '+';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '#';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM atom WHERE element != 'br'
SELECT COUNT(molecule_id) FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR000' AND 'TR099' AND label = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c';

SELECT DISTINCT T2.element, T3.element
FROM connected AS T1
JOIN atom AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T1.atom_id2 = T3.atom_id
WHERE T1.bond_id = 'TR004_8_9';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.element
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.bond_id = T3.bond_id
WHERE T3.bond_type = '=';
SELECT m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE a.element = 'h' GROUP BY m.label ORDER BY COUNT(a.atom_id) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id OR a.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE a.element = 'cl';
SELECT atom_id, atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id IN (SELECT bond_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = '-')

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(a.element) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE (a1.atom_id = 'TR004_8' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR004_20')
   OR (a1.atom_id = 'TR004_20' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR004_8');

SELECT DISTINCT m.label
FROM molecule m
WHERE m.label NOT IN (
    SELECT m2.label
    FROM molecule m2
    JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
    WHERE a.element = 'sn'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT atom.atom_id) FROM atom JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '-' AND atom.element IN ('i', 's');
SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2 FROM connected JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT c.atom_id2 AS atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR181';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN a.atom_id IS NULL THEN m.molecule_id END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM molecule m
LEFT JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id AND a.element = 'f'
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100 / COUNT(bond_id) AS percent
FROM bond
JOIN molecule ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.label = '+'
SELECT DISTINCT atom.element FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR000' ORDER BY atom.element ASC LIMIT 3

SELECT c.atom_id, c.atom_id2
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_6'
  AND m.molecule_id = 'TR001';
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN label = '-' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference FROM molecule;

SELECT connected.atom_id, connected.atom_id2
FROM connected
JOIN bond ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE bond.bond_id = 'TR000_2_5';
SELECT b.bond_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE c.atom_id2 = 'TR000_2'

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
ORDER BY m.label
LIMIT 5;

SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '=' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(b.bond_id), 5) AS percentage
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR008';
SELECT ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id), 3) AS percent FROM molecule m

SELECT ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.element = 'h' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(a.atom_id), 4) AS percentage
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR206'
SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, m.label
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR060';

SELECT b.bond_type, m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR010'
GROUP BY b.bond_type, m.label
ORDER BY COUNT(b.bond_type) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
JOIN connected ON connected.bond_id = bond.bond_id
WHERE molecule.label = '-' AND bond.bond_type = '-'
ORDER BY molecule.molecule_id
LIMIT 3;

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR006'
ORDER BY b.bond_type ASC
LIMIT 2;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id)
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE b.molecule_id = 'TR009'
  AND (c.atom_id = 'TR009_12' OR c.atom_id2 = 'TR009_12');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'br';
SELECT b.bond_type, c.atom_id, c.atom_id2 FROM bond b JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_6_9';
SELECT molecule.molecule_id, molecule.label FROM atom JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id WHERE atom.atom_id = 'TR001_10'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT bond.molecule_id) FROM bond WHERE bond.bond_type = '#';

SELECT COUNT(c.bond_id)
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE a.atom_id LIKE 'TR%_19';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR004';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM molecule WHERE label = '-'
SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id, m.label FROM molecule m JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) BETWEEN '21' AND '25' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT b.bond_id FROM bond AS b JOIN connected AS c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom AS a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom AS a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE (a1.element = 'p' AND a2.element = 'n') OR (a1.element = 'n' AND a2.element = 'p');

SELECT CASE WHEN (SELECT label FROM molecule WHERE molecule_id = (SELECT molecule_id FROM bond WHERE bond_type = ' = ' GROUP BY molecule_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1)) = '+' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS is_carcinogenic;
SELECT CAST(COUNT(T2.bond_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT T1.atom_id) FROM atom AS T1 JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id WHERE T1.element = 'i'

SELECT DISTINCT b.bond_type, b.bond_id
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
WHERE SUBSTR(a.atom_id, 7, 2) + 0 = 45;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
LEFT JOIN connected c1 ON a.atom_id = c1.atom_id
LEFT JOIN connected c2 ON a.atom_id = c2.atom_id2
WHERE c1.atom_id IS NULL AND c2.atom_id2 IS NULL;

SELECT a1.atom_id, a2.atom_id FROM molecule m JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR041' AND b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN connected c ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR144_8_19';
SELECT molecule_id FROM molecule WHERE label = '+' ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond WHERE bond.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id AND bond_type = ' = ') DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY a.element
ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T3.atom_id
FROM atom AS T1
JOIN connected AS T2 ON T1.atom_id = T2.atom_id
JOIN atom AS T3 ON T3.atom_id = T2.atom_id2
WHERE T1.element = 'pb';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#';

SELECT 100.0 * MAX(t.cnt) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bond) AS percentage
FROM (
    SELECT a1.element AS element1, a2.element AS element2, COUNT(*) AS cnt

WITH czk_totals AS (
    SELECT c.CustomerID, c.Segment, SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM customers c
    JOIN yearmonth y ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
    GROUP BY c.CustomerID, c.Segment
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_consumption
    FROM czk_totals
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT t.Segment, SUM(t.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM czk_totals t
    JOIN seg_min m ON t.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total_consumption = m.min_consumption
    GROUP BY t.Segment
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS "SME_minus_LAM",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'LAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) AS "LAM_minus_KAM",
    MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'KAM' THEN annual_avg END) - MAX(CASE WHEN Segment = 'SME' THEN annual_avg END) AS "KAM_minus_SME"
FROM seg_avg

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = ym.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_increase
    FROM seg
)
SELECT
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase DESC LIMIT 1) AS biggest_increase,
    (SELECT Segment FROM pct ORDER BY pct_increase ASC LIMIT 1) AS lowest_increase;
