SELECT AVG(d.A15)
FROM district AS d
INNER JOIN account AS a ON d.district_id = a.district_id
WHERE d.A15 > 4000
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', a.date) >= '1997';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.card_id)
FROM card c
JOIN disp d ON c.disp_id = d.disp_id
WHERE c.type = 'classic'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M' AND d.A2 = 'Hl.m. Praha';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT d.A15
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.account_id = 532;

SELECT account.district_id
FROM account
JOIN `order` ON account.account_id = `order`.account_id
WHERE `order`.order_id = 33333;

SELECT t.*
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3356
  AND t.operation = 'VYBER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND l.amount < 200000;

SELECT card.type
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN card ON disp.disp_id = card.disp_id
WHERE client.client_id = 13539;

SELECT d.A3
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.client_id = 3541;

SELECT d.A2 AS district
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE l.status = 'A'
GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A2
ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT c.client_id, c.gender, c.birth_date
FROM `order` o
JOIN disp d ON o.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE o.order_id = 32423;

SELECT t.*
FROM trans t
JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.district_id = 5;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Jesenik';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card ca ON d.disp_id = ca.disp_id
WHERE ca.type = 'junior'
  AND ca.issued >= '1997-01-01';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN cl.gender = 'F' THEN cl.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT cl.client_id) AS percentage_women
FROM client cl
JOIN disp dp ON cl.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account ac ON dp.account_id = ac.account_id
JOIN district di ON ac.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE di.A11 > 10000;

SELECT
    (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1997' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END))
    * 100.0
    / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) = '1996' THEN l.amount ELSE 0 END) AS growth_rate
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND SUBSTR(l.date, 1, 4) IN ('1996', '1997');

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM trans 
INNER JOIN account ON trans.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE trans.operation = 'VYBER KARTOU' 
  AND trans.date >= '960101';

SELECT COUNT(d.disp_id)
FROM disp d
INNER JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.account_id BETWEEN 1 AND 10
  AND d.type IN ('OWNER', 'DISPONENT');

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*)
     FROM trans t
     JOIN account a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    WHERE a.account_id = 3
      AND t.k_symbol = 'SLUZBY') AS statement_requests,
  (SELECT t2.k_symbol
     FROM trans t2
     JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = t2.account_id
    WHERE a2.account_id = 3
      AND t2.type = 'VYDAJ'
    GROUP BY t2.k_symbol
   HAVING SUM(t2.amount) = 3539) AS debit_purpose;

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', client.birth_date) AS birth_year
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 130
  AND disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN disp d ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'OWNER'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.amount AS loan_amount,
       l.payments AS monthly_payment,
       l.duration,
       l.status,
       (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)
          FROM trans t
         WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
           AND t.k_symbol = 'UROV') AS paid_so_far,
       l.amount - (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0)
                     FROM trans t
                    WHERE t.account_id = l.account_id
                      AND t.k_symbol = 'UROV') AS remaining_debt
FROM loan l
WHERE l.account_id IN (SELECT d.account_id
                         FROM disp d
                        WHERE d.client_id = 992);

SELECT SUM(t.amount) AS total_amount,
       c.gender
FROM disp d
JOIN client c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON t.account_id = d.account_id
WHERE d.client_id = 4
  AND t.trans_id > 851
GROUP BY c.gender;

SELECT card.type
FROM card
JOIN disp ON card.disp_id = disp.disp_id
JOIN client ON disp.client_id = client.client_id
WHERE client.client_id = 9;

SELECT SUM(t.amount)
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans AS t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.client_id = 617
  AND t.date LIKE '1998%';

SELECT DISTINCT c.client_id, c.birth_date
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district di ON a.district_id = di.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date BETWEEN '1983-01-01' AND '1987-12-31'
  AND di.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT c.client_id, l.loan_id
FROM loan l
JOIN disp d ON l.account_id = d.account_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY l.amount DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id)
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN trans t ON d.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'
  AND c.birth_date BETWEEN '1974-01-01' AND '1976-12-31'
  AND t.k_symbol = 'SIPO'
  AND t.amount > 4000;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A2 = 'Beroun'
  AND account.date > '1996-12-31';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS female_junior_card_customers
FROM card ca
JOIN disp d ON ca.disp_id = d.disp_id
JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND ca.type = 'junior';

SELECT 100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN client.gender = 'F' THEN client.client_id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT client.client_id) AS pct_female
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON account.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE district.A3 = 'Prague';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN c.client_id END) AS REAL) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS percentage_male
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_clients
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT a.account_id, a.date, l.amount
FROM account a
JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE l.duration > 24
  AND l.status = 'A'
  AND a.date < '1997-01-01'
ORDER BY l.amount ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT account.account_id
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN account ON disp.account_id = account.account_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE client.gender = 'F'
ORDER BY client.birth_date ASC, district.A11 ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.birth_date LIKE '1920%' 
  AND district.A3 = 'east Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM loan 
JOIN account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id 
WHERE loan.duration = 24 
  AND account.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE';

SELECT AVG(l.amount) AS average_running_loan_amount
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE l.status IN ('C', 'D')
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT client.client_id, district.A2
FROM client
JOIN disp ON client.client_id = disp.client_id
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT c.client_id,
       (CAST(strftime('%Y', date('now')) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)) AS age
FROM client AS c
JOIN disp AS d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN card AS cd ON d.disp_id = cd.disp_id
WHERE cd.type = 'gold'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT major.major_name
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Angela' AND member.last_name = 'Sanders';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_students
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE major.college = 'College of Engineering';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.department = 'Art and Design';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.link_to_member) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT m.phone
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Women''s Soccer';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS num_students
FROM attendance a
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
WHERE e.event_name = "Women's Soccer" AND m.t_shirt_size = 'Medium';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN member AS m ON a.link_to_member = m.member_id
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
ORDER BY COUNT(a.link_to_event) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
WHERE m.first_name = 'Maya' AND m.last_name = 'Mclean';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT event.event_id)
FROM attendance
JOIN member ON attendance.link_to_member = member.member_id
JOIN event ON attendance.link_to_event = event.event_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Sacha'
  AND member.last_name = 'Harrison'
  AND YEAR(event.event_date) = 2019;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM event e
JOIN (
    SELECT link_to_event
    FROM attendance
    GROUP BY link_to_event
    HAVING COUNT(link_to_member) > 10
) a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
WHERE e.type != 'Fundraiser'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING COUNT(a.link_to_event) > 20;

SELECT COUNT(a.link_to_member) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT e.event_name) AS average_attendance
FROM event AS e
JOIN attendance AS a ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.type = 'Meeting'
  AND YEAR(e.event_date) = 2020;

SELECT T1.expense_description
FROM expense AS T1
JOIN budget AS T2 ON T1.link_to_budget = T2.budget_id
JOIN event AS T3 ON T2.link_to_event = T3.event_id
ORDER BY T1.cost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id)
FROM member m
JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id
WHERE ma.major_name = 'Environmental Engineering';

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN attendance a ON m.member_id = a.link_to_member
JOIN event e ON a.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'Laugh Out Loud';

SELECT m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE mj.major_name = 'Law and Constitutional Studies';

SELECT z.county
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.first_name = 'Sherri'
  AND m.last_name = 'Ramsey';

SELECT major.college
FROM member
JOIN major ON member.link_to_major = major.major_id
WHERE member.first_name = 'Tyler'
  AND member.last_name = 'Hewitt';

SELECT income.amount
FROM income
JOIN member ON income.link_to_member = member.member_id
WHERE member.position = 'Vice President';

SELECT SUM(b.spent) AS total_spent
FROM budget b
JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
WHERE e.event_name = 'September Meeting'
  AND b.category = 'Food';

SELECT z.city, z.state
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE m.position = 'President';

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN zip_code z ON m.zip = z.zip_code
WHERE z.state = 'Illinois';
SELECT SUM(b.spent) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE b.category = 'Advertisement' AND e.event_name = 'September Meeting'

SELECT DISTINCT major.department
FROM major
JOIN member ON major.major_id = member.link_to_major
WHERE member.last_name IN ('Pierce', 'Guidi');
SELECT SUM(b.amount) FROM budget b JOIN event e ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id WHERE e.event_name = 'October Speaker';

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = SUM(CASE WHEN approved = 'True' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) THEN 'True' ELSE 'False' END AS all_approved
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_budget IN (
    SELECT budget_id
    FROM budget
    WHERE link_to_event IN (
        SELECT event_id
        FROM event
        WHERE event_name = 'October Meeting'
          AND event_date = '2019-10-08'
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT p.player_name
FROM Player p
JOIN Match m
  ON p.player_api_id IN (
      m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
      m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10,
      m.home_player_11, m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4,
      m.away_player_5, m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9,
      m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
  )
JOIN Country c
  ON m.country_id = c.id
WHERE c.name = 'Belgium';

SELECT DISTINCT P.player_name, C.name AS country
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
JOIN Match M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN Country C ON C.id = M.country_id
WHERE PA.vision > 89;

SELECT c.name
FROM Country c
JOIN Match m ON m.country_id = c.id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
        m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
        m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
        m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
        m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
     )
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY AVG(p.weight) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_long_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT P.height)
FROM Player AS P
JOIN Match AS M ON P.player_api_id IN (M.home_player_1, M.home_player_2, M.home_player_3, M.home_player_4, M.home_player_5, M.home_player_6, M.home_player_7, M.home_player_8, M.home_player_9, M.home_player_10, M.home_player_11, M.away_player_1, M.away_player_2, M.away_player_3, M.away_player_4, M.away_player_5, M.away_player_6, M.away_player_7, M.away_player_8, M.away_player_9, M.away_player_10, M.away_player_11)
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country AS C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE C.name = 'Italy';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.player_name
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.height > 180
ORDER BY T1.player_name
LIMIT 3;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.player_api_id)
FROM Player AS T1
JOIN Player_Attributes AS T2 ON T1.player_api_id = T2.player_api_id
WHERE T1.player_name LIKE 'Aaron%'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T1.birthday) > '1990';

SELECT PA.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes AS PA
JOIN Player AS P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY PA.player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(PA.potential) ASC
LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id) AS num_players
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
    WHERE preferred_foot = 'left'
) M ON PA.crossing = M.max_crossing
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left';
SELECT c.name FROM League l JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id WHERE l.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT T1.team_long_name AS home_team, M.home_team_goal, T2.team_long_name AS away_team, M.away_team_goal
FROM Match AS M
JOIN League AS L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team AS T1 ON M.home_team_api_id = T1.team_api_id
JOIN Team AS T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT T.team_long_name, TA.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE T.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS games_played
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND c.name = 'Italy'
  AND l.name = 'Serie A';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Country C ON L.country_id = C.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT l.name, COUNT(m.id) AS num_games
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY l.name
ORDER BY num_games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match M
JOIN Team T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match);

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player_Attributes PA
JOIN Player P ON PA.player_api_id = P.player_api_id
ORDER BY PA.overall_rating DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'
  AND d.A3 = 'East Bohemia';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
LEFT JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague' AND l.loan_id IS NULL;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id)
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM client 
JOIN district ON client.district_id = district.district_id 
WHERE client.gender = 'M' 
  AND district.A3 = 'North Bohemia' 
  AND district.A11 > 8000;

SELECT acc.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(dg.A11) FROM district dg) - MIN(dd.A11) AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN district dd ON dd.district_id = c.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = dp.account_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2 WHERE c2.gender = 'F')
  AND dd.A11 = (
        SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
        FROM client c3
        JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c3.district_id
        WHERE c3.gender = 'F'
          AND c3.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c4.birth_date) FROM client c4 WHERE c4.gender = 'F')
  )
GROUP BY dd.A11;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = dp.account_id
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(c2.birth_date) FROM client c2)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(d2.A11) FROM district d2);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK TYDNE'
  AND d.type = 'OWNER';

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.client_id = d.client_id
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id
WHERE d.type = 'DISPONENT'
  AND a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU';

SELECT l.account_id
FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = l.account_id
JOIN (

LEFT JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
GROUP BY e.expense_description
HAVING SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(e.expense_id) > 50;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
LEFT JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN z.type = 'PO Box' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(z.zip_code) AS po_box_percentage

SELECT e.event_name, e.location
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event
WHERE b.remaining > 0;

SELECT event_name, event_date
FROM event
WHERE event_id IN (
    SELECT b.link_to_event
    FROM budget b
    WHERE b.budget_id IN (
        SELECT e.link_to_budget
        FROM expense e
        WHERE e.expense_description = 'Pizza'
          AND e.cost > 50
          AND e.cost < 100
    )
);

SELECT DISTINCT m.first_name, m.last_name, mj.major_name
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN major mj ON m.link_to_major = mj.major_id
WHERE e.cost > 100;

SELECT z.city, z.county
FROM event e
JOIN attendance a ON e.event_id = a.link_to_event
JOIN income i ON i.link_to_member = a.link_to_member
JOIN zip_code z ON e.location = z.zip_code
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name, z.city, z.county
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT i.income_id) > 40;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM member m
JOIN expense e ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
GROUP BY m.member_id, m.first_name, m.last_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev.event_id) > 1
ORDER BY SUM(e.cost) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT E.event_name
FROM event E
JOIN budget B ON E.event_id = B.link_to_event
JOIN expense X ON X.link_to_budget = B.budget_id
WHERE B.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY E.event_id, E.event_name
HAVING SUM(X.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(X2.cost) / COUNT(E2.event_id)
    FROM event E2
    JOIN budget B2 ON E2.event_id = B2.link_to_event
    JOIN expense X2 ON X2.link_to_budget = B2.budget_id
    WHERE B2.category = 'Parking'
);

SELECT SUM(cost) * 100.0 /
       (SELECT COUNT(event_id)
        FROM event
        WHERE type = 'Meeting')
FROM expense
WHERE link_to_budget IN (
        SELECT budget_id
        FROM budget
        WHERE link_to_event IN (
                SELECT event_id
                FROM event
                WHERE type = 'Meeting'
        )
);

SELECT b.budget_id, b.category

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cf.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(cf.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 cf
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cf.Segment = m.Segment AND cf.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cf.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Biggest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Lowest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

    FROM connected c
    JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
    JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
    WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR001_1_8'
      AND ((a1.element = 'cl' AND a2.element = 'c')
        OR (a1.element = 'c' AND a2.element = 'cl'))
) THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END;

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = '#'
LIMIT 2;

SELECT DISTINCT
  CASE a.element
    WHEN 'cl' THEN 'Chlorine'
    WHEN 'c'  THEN 'Carbon'
    WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
  END AS element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id IN (
    SELECT atom_id  FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
);

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_c
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_cons
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_cons m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_c
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

    FROM yearmonth ym

    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')

)

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS name_count
    FROM admin_names
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY name_count DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT a.first_name, a.district
FROM admin_names a
JOIN name_counts nc ON a.first_name = nc.first_name
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.district, nc.name_count
ORDER BY nc.name_count DESC, a.first_name, a.district;

FROM superhero AS s
GROUP BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS male_god_eternal_count
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE r.id = 21
  AND g.id = 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MAX(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN attribute a2 ON a2.id = ha2.attribute_id
      WHERE a2.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  );

SELECT COUNT(*) AS superhero_count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
WHERE alignment.id = 3;

SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour eye ON s.eye_colour_id = eye.id
JOIN colour hair ON s.hair_colour_id = hair.id
WHERE eye.colour = 'Blue'
  AND hair.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT p.publisher_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name IN ('Hawkman', 'Karate Kid', 'Speedy');

SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_superheroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.id = 1;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN (SELECT MAX(height_cm) AS max_height FROM superhero) m
  ON s.height_cm = m.max_height;
SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'cryokinesis';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
LEFT JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE s.id = 294;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Karen Beecher-Duncan';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.full_name = 'Helen Parr';

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 108
  AND superhero.height_cm = 188;

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Blue'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_female_count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 1
  AND gender.id = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.hair_colour_id = colour.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'blue'
  AND gender.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(superhero.id) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT SUM(c.id = 7) - SUM(c.id = 1) AS difference
FROM superhero AS s
JOIN colour AS c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 0 OR s.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(s.id) AS total
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE c.colour = 'Green'
  AND a.alignment = 'Bad';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS female_marvel_heroes
FROM superhero s
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE g.gender = 'Female'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON s.id = hp.hero_id
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY s.superhero_name;

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm)
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_hero_count
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN attribute a ON ha.attribute_id = a.id
WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  AND ha.attribute_value = (
      SELECT MIN(ha2.attribute_value)
      FROM hero_attribute ha2
      JOIN superhero s2 ON s2.id = ha2.hero_id
      WHERE s2.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
  );

SELECT colour.colour
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.superhero_name = 'Abomination';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN (SELECT MAX(height_cm) AS max_height FROM superhero) m
  ON s.height_cm = m.max_height;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT s.id
FROM superhero AS s
INNER JOIN hero_attribute AS ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT superhero.id
FROM superhero
JOIN hero_power ON superhero.id = hero_power.hero_id
JOIN superpower ON hero_power.power_id = superpower.id
WHERE superpower.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
JOIN superhero s ON hp.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS in_patient_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS outpatient_count,
       CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS REAL)
           / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS deviation_percentage
FROM Patient p
LEFT JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER) > 1930 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(ID) AS percentage
FROM (SELECT ID, Birthday FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F') AS female_patients

SELECT CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Admission = '+' AND strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940') AS REAL) * 100 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940')

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '+' THEN p.ID END) AS REAL)
     / COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.Admission = '-' THEN p.ID END) AS ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.LDH > '500';
SELECT T1.ID, SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(T1.Birthday)) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.RVVT = '+'

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) = '1937'
  AND L.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Laboratory.TP < '6.0' OR Laboratory.TP > '8.5' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(Patient.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(`aCL IgG`)
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Admission = '+'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) >= 50
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Description) = '1997'
  AND T1.Admission = '-'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = '1'
  AND e."Examination Date" LIKE '1997%'
  AND p.SEX = 'F';

SELECT
  (SELECT MAX(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
   FROM Patient
   WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200))
  -
  (SELECT MIN(CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER))
   FROM Patient
   WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE TG >= 200)) AS age_gap;

SELECT Symptoms, Diagnosis
FROM Examination
WHERE ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Birthday = (
        SELECT MAX(Birthday)
        FROM Patient
        WHERE ID IN (
            SELECT ID
            FROM Examination
        )
    )
);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT T2.Date,
       (STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday)) AS age_at_first_arrival
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE (YEAR(T2.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(T1.`First Date`)) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE YEAR(Patient.Birthday) < 18
  AND YEAR(Examination.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M' AND L.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT YEAR(E.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age, E.Diagnosis
FROM Examination E
JOIN Patient P ON E.ID = P.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = E.ID
ORDER BY L.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e.`ANA`
FROM `Examination` e
JOIN `Patient` p ON e.`ID` = p.`ID`
WHERE e.`ID` = 3605340
  AND e.`Examination Date` = '1996-12-02';

SELECT CASE WHEN L.`T-CHO` < 250 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS normal_level
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 2927464
  AND L.Date = '1995-09-04';

SELECT p.SEX
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY p."First Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT e."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND p.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND e."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12';
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Date = '1992-06-12' AND T2.GPT = '9'

SELECT YEAR(l.`Date`) - YEAR(p.Birthday) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.`Date` = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(l.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND l.Date LIKE '1995%';

SELECT Patient.Diagnosis
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT E."Symptoms"
FROM "Patient" P
JOIN "Examination" E ON P."ID" = E."ID"
WHERE P."Birthday" = '1959-03-01'
  AND E."Examination Date" = '1993-09-27';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND E.`Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
  AND E.`Examination Date` < '1998-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND L.GPT > 30
  AND L.ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(Patient.Birthday) = 1964
  AND Patient.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.`Thrombosis` = 2
  AND Examination.`ANA` = 'S'
  AND Examination.`aCL IgM` > (
      SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) + AVG(`aCL IgM`) * 0.2
      FROM Examination
  );

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.`UA` <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.`U-PRO` > 0 AND Laboratory.`U-PRO` < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN P.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET' THEN P.ID END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) = '1981';

SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday, Description, `First Date`, Admission, Diagnosis
FROM Patient
WHERE Admission = '-'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Laboratory
      WHERE `Date` LIKE '1991-10%'
        AND `T-BIL` < 2.0
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`ANA Pattern` != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;
SELECT AVG(Laboratory.ALB) FROM Laboratory JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.PLT > 400 AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'SLE'

SELECT E.Symptoms
FROM Examination AS E
JOIN Patient AS P ON E.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY E.Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(E.Symptoms) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Description, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = 48473;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Patient.Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = '1997'
  AND (l.TP <= 6 OR l.TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis LIKE '%ITP%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
     / SUM(CASE WHEN e.Diagnosis LIKE '%SLE%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS proportion
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE e.Symptoms LIKE '%thrombocytopenia%';

SELECT SUM(P.SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(P.SEX)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE YEAR(P.Birthday) = '1980' AND P.Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Examination.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND Examination.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND Patient.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.WBC < 3.5

SELECT DATEDIFF(e.`Examination Date`, p.`First Date`)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = 57266
  AND ((P.SEX = 'M' AND L.UA > 8.0) OR (P.SEX = 'F' AND L.UA > 6.5));

SELECT L.Date
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.ID = '48473'
  AND L.GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.GOT < 60
  AND strftime('%Y', Laboratory.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.GPT >= 60;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
SELECT AVG(T2.LDH) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.LDH < 500;

SELECT p.ID, SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(p.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.ALP < 300;

SELECT P.ID, CASE WHEN L.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "ALP within normal range"
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TP < 6.0;

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.*
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE
         WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes'
         ELSE 'No'
       END AS [Albumin within normal range]
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.SEX = 'F'

SELECT AVG(T2.UA)
FROM Patient T1
JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) M ON T1.ID = M.ID
JOIN Laboratory T2 ON T2.ID = M.ID AND T2.Date = M.LatestDate
WHERE (T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.UA < 8.0) OR (T1.SEX = 'F' AND T2.UA < 6.5);

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND l.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
INNER JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT P.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY P.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID

HAVING COUNT(b.bond_type) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cf.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(cf.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 cf
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cf.Segment = m.Segment AND cf.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cf.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Biggest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Lowest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cons AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM czk)
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t.total) AS min_total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, t.total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN seg_min m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_increase
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct_increase
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND (
      percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))
      OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))

SELECT a.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                                          FROM client c2
                                          JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id
                                          WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                                            AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')) AS gap

JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
               FROM client c2
               JOIN district d2 ON c2.district_id = d2.district_id

                 AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'));

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_c
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_cons
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_cons m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_c
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_early AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_late AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ((SELECT balance FROM bal_late) - (SELECT balance FROM bal_early)) * 100.0
    / (SELECT balance FROM bal_early) AS increase_rate;

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE m.member_id IN (
    SELECT e2.link_to_member
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2.budget_id = e2.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
)
ORDER BY e.cost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(x.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(x2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
    FROM event e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
    JOIN expense x2 ON x2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);

JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE c.bond_id = 'TR000_2_3';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.bond_id) AS num_bonds
FROM connected c
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.element = 'cl'
  AND a2.element = 'cl';

SELECT atom.atom_id, COUNT(bond.bond_type) AS bond_type_count
FROM atom
JOIN bond ON atom.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE atom.molecule_id = 'TR346'
GROUP BY atom.atom_id;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM bond AS b
JOIN molecule AS m ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = ' AND m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.element <> 's'
  AND b.bond_type <> ' = ';

SELECT m.label
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_2_4';

SELECT COUNT(atom.atom_id)
FROM atom
JOIN molecule ON atom.molecule_id = molecule.molecule_id
WHERE molecule.molecule_id = 'TR001';

SELECT COUNT(b.bond_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'cl'
  AND m.label = '+';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.element = 'c'
  AND m.label = '-';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM bond b
JOIN molecule m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_1_7';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.element) AS num_elements
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON a.atom_id = c.atom_id
WHERE b.bond_id = 'TR001_3_4';

SELECT b.bond_type
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_1' AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_2';

SELECT a1.molecule_id
FROM atom AS a1
JOIN atom AS a2 ON a1.molecule_id = a2.molecule_id
WHERE a1.atom_id = 'TR000_2'
  AND a2.atom_id = 'TR000_4';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR000_1';

SELECT m.molecule_id, m.label
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR000';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'n';

SELECT DISTINCT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE a.element = 's' AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON m.molecule_id = a.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '-'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(m.molecule_id) > 5;

SELECT DISTINCT a.element
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
JOIN atom a ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR024'
  AND b.bond_type = '=';

SELECT m.molecule_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+'
GROUP BY m.molecule_id
HAVING COUNT(a.atom_id) = (
    SELECT MAX(cnt)
    FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(a2.atom_id) AS cnt
        FROM molecule m2
        JOIN atom a2 ON a2.molecule_id = m2.molecule_id
        WHERE m2.label = '+'
        GROUP BY m2.molecule_id
    ) AS counts
);

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.label = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(m.molecule_id) AS percentage
FROM connected c
JOIN bond b
    ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1
    ON c.atom_id = a1.atom_id
JOIN atom a2
    ON c.atom_id2 = a2.atom_id
JOIN molecule m
    ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE b.bond_type = '#'
  AND a1.element = 'h'
  AND a2.element = 'h';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.molecule_id)
FROM molecule m
JOIN bond b ON m.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id BETWEEN 'TR004' AND 'TR010'
  AND b.bond_type = '-';

SELECT COUNT(a.atom_id) AS carbon_count
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.molecule_id = 'TR008'
  AND a.element = 'c';

SELECT a.element
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE a.atom_id = 'TR004_7' AND m.label = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT b.molecule_id)
FROM bond b
JOIN connected c ON c.bond_id = b.bond_id
JOIN atom a1 ON a1.atom_id = c.atom_id
JOIN atom a2 ON a2.atom_id = c.atom_id2
WHERE b.bond_type = ' = '
  AND (a1.element = 'o' OR a2.element = 'o');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT molecule.molecule_id) AS non_carcinogenic_count
FROM molecule
JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
WHERE bond.bond_type = '#'
  AND molecule.label = '-';

SELECT DISTINCT a.element, b.bond_type
FROM atom a
JOIN bond b ON a.molecule_id = b.molecule_id
WHERE a.molecule_id = 'TR002';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM molecule m
JOIN atom a ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
JOIN connected c ON c.atom_id = a.atom_id
JOIN bond b ON b.bond_id = c.bond_id
WHERE m.label = 'TR012'
  AND a.element = 'c'
  AND b.bond_type = ' = ';

SELECT a.atom_id
FROM atom a
JOIN molecule m ON a.molecule_id = m.molecule_id
WHERE m.label = '+' AND a.element = 'o';

       frpm.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` * 1.0 / frpm.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS eligible_free_rate

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           ym.CustomerID AS CustomerID,
           SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, ym.CustomerID
),
min_per_segment AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(total_consumption) AS min_total
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
annual_avg AS (
    SELECT cf.Segment AS Segment,
           SUM(cf.total_consumption) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS avg_consumption
    FROM czk_2013 cf
    JOIN min_per_segment m
      ON cf.Segment = m.Segment AND cf.total_consumption = m.min_total
    GROUP BY cf.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT avg_consumption FROM annual_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH seg AS (
    SELECT c.Segment,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2012,
           SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS cons2013
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
pct AS (
    SELECT Segment,
           (cons2013 - cons2012) * 100.0 / cons2013 AS pct_change
    FROM seg
)
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Biggest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM (
    SELECT 'Lowest increase' AS Type, Segment, pct_change
    FROM pct
    ORDER BY pct_change ASC
    LIMIT 1
);

WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT AdmFName1 AS first_name, District AS district
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName2, District
    FROM schools
    UNION ALL
    SELECT AdmFName3, District
    FROM schools
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT first_name, COUNT(*) AS name_count
    FROM admin_names
    WHERE first_name IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(first_name) <> ''
    GROUP BY first_name
    ORDER BY name_count DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
SELECT a.first_name, a.district
FROM admin_names a
JOIN name_counts nc ON a.first_name = nc.first_name
GROUP BY a.first_name, a.district, nc.name_count
ORDER BY nc.name_count DESC, a.first_name, a.district;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE publisher.publisher_name = 'George Lucas'

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT COUNT(id) FROM superhero WHERE full_name LIKE 'John%';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_attribute WHERE attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);
SELECT full_name FROM superhero WHERE superhero_name = 'Alien';

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100 AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT s.weight_kg, r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'neutral';
SELECT hero_id FROM hero_power WHERE power_id IN (SELECT id FROM superpower WHERE power_name = 'Intelligence')

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (SELECT AVG(height_cm) * 0.8 FROM superhero);
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) BETWEEN '1930' AND '1940';
SELECT CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN 1 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN 1 END) FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T1.Diagnosis, T2.Date
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '30609';

SELECT T1.SEX, T1.Birthday, T2.`Examination Date`, T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.ID = '163109'

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID,
       CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.RVVT = '+';
SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
SELECT DISTINCT T1.* FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALB < 3.5;
SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T1.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.TP < 6.0 OR T2.TP > 8.5

SELECT AVG(T2."aCL IgG")
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(T1.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER)) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Description) = '1997' AND Admission = '-';
SELECT MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', "First Date") AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Birthday) AS INTEGER)) FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', E."Examination Date") = '1997'
  AND E."Thrombosis" = '1'
  AND P."SEX" = 'F';

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY T2.Birthday DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12.0
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M';

SELECT T1.Date, strftime('%Y', T2.`First Date`) - strftime('%Y', T2.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
ORDER BY T2.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= '8.0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= '6.5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
FROM Laboratory AS l
JOIN Patient AS p ON l.ID = p.ID

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE (CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.`First Date`) AS INTEGER)) >= 1

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1993'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', T2.`Examination Date`) - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 18;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ID) 
FROM Laboratory l 
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID 
WHERE p.SEX = 'M' AND l.`T-BIL` >= '2.0';
SELECT Diagnosis FROM Examination WHERE `Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31' GROUP BY Diagnosis ORDER BY COUNT(Diagnosis) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT strftime('%Y', e.`Examination Date`) - strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS age, p.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS e
JOIN Patient AS p ON e.ID = p.ID
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON l.ID = e.ID
ORDER BY l.HGB DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT ANA FROM Examination WHERE ID = 3605340 AND `Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'
SELECT CASE WHEN "T-CHO" < 250 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 2927464 AND Date = '1995-09-04';
SELECT SEX FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS' ORDER BY "First Date" LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2."aCL IgM"
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T1.Description = '1994-02-19'
  AND T2."Examination Date" = '1993-11-12'
SELECT T1.SEX FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT = '9' AND T2.Date = '1992-06-12'

SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y', l.Date) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1995'

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."Examination Date" = '1997-01-27'
  AND T2.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT T2.Symptoms
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1959/03/01'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` = '1993/09/27';

     - SUM(CASE WHEN Laboratory.Date LIKE '1981-12-%' THEN Laboratory."T-CHO" ELSE 0 END) AS decrease_rate
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Patient.Birthday = '1959-02-18';
SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Patient WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%' AND Description >= '1997-01-01' AND Description < '1998-01-01';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31' AND GPT > 30 AND ALB < 4;
SELECT ID, COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Birthday LIKE '1964%' AND Admission = '+' GROUP BY ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Thrombosis` = 2

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'

  AND L."T-BIL" < 2.0;

FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2."ANA Pattern" != 'P'
  AND T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1980' AND '1989';

SELECT DISTINCT T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT Symptoms FROM Examination WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE' GROUP BY Symptoms ORDER BY COUNT(Symptoms) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT Description, Diagnosis FROM Patient WHERE ID = 48473;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F' AND Diagnosis = 'APS';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ID)
FROM Laboratory
WHERE strftime('%Y', Date) = '1997'
  AND (TP <= 6 OR TP >= 8.5);
SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') * 100.0 / COUNT(SEX) FROM Patient WHERE strftime('%Y', Birthday) = '1980' AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND e."Examination Date" BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'BEHCET'
  AND p.Admission = '-';
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) FROM Patient p JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND l.WBC < 3.5;

FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Patient.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.ID = 57266

SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = 48473 AND GOT >= 60

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX, T1.Birthday
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.GOT < 60 AND strftime('%Y', T2.Date) = '1994';

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.GPT >= 60;
SELECT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.GPT > 60 ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, CAST(strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission FROM Patient AS T1 WHERE T1.ID IN (SELECT T2.ID FROM Laboratory AS T2 WHERE T2.ALP < 300)

SELECT T1.ID, CASE WHEN T2.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS ALP_Normal
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday = '1982-04-01'

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, SEX, Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE TP < 6.0;

SELECT Laboratory.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND Laboratory.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.*
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND (Laboratory.ALB <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Birthday, l.ALB,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Within normal range' ELSE 'Out of normal range' END AS ALB_Status
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) = '1982';

SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN Laboratory.UA > 6.5 THEN Patient.ID END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT ID, MAX(Date) AS LatestDate
    FROM Laboratory
    GROUP BY ID
) AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID AND T1.Date = T2.LatestDate
INNER JOIN Patient AS T3 ON T1.ID = T3.ID
WHERE (T3.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0)
   OR (T3.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5);
SELECT ID, SEX, Birthday FROM Patient WHERE ID IN (SELECT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE UN = 29);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Diagnosis = 'RA' AND Laboratory.UN < 30;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5

SELECT SUM(Patient.SEX = 'M') > SUM(Patient.SEX = 'F') AS Result
FROM Patient
INNER JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L."T-BIL" = (SELECT MAX("T-BIL") FROM Laboratory);

SELECT Patient.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT Patient.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory."T-BIL" >= 2.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX;

SELECT p.ID, l."T-CHO"
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l."T-CHO" = (SELECT MAX("T-CHO") FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p."Birthday" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(strftime('%Y', 'now') - strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday)) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory."T-CHO" >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.TG > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GLU >= 180 AND L.[T-CHO] < 250;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.GLU
FROM Laboratory AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE SUBSTR(T2.Description, 1, 4) = '1991'
  AND T1.GLU < 180;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.WBC <= 3.5 OR L.WBC >= 9.0
ORDER BY P.SEX ASC,
         (CAST((julianday('now') - julianday(P.Birthday)) / 365.2425 AS INTEGER)) ASC;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.Diagnosis, CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.RBC < 3.5

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER) >= 50
  AND (T2.RBC <= 3.5 OR T2.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.Admission = '-' AND Laboratory.HGB < 10;

FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND L.HGB > 10
  AND L.HGB < 17
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T1.ID, strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY T1.ID
HAVING COUNT(T2.ID) > 2
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS lower_than_normal,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_than_normal,
       SUM(CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Description, p.`First Date`, p.Admission, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS p
JOIN Laboratory AS l ON p.ID = l.ID
