    WHEN 'h'  THEN 'Hydrogen'
    WHEN 'o'  THEN 'Oxygen'
    WHEN 's'  THEN 'Sulfur'
    WHEN 'n'  THEN 'Nitrogen'
    WHEN 'p'  THEN 'Phosphorus'
    WHEN 'na' THEN 'Sodium'
    WHEN 'br' THEN 'Bromine'
    WHEN 'f'  THEN 'Fluorine'
    WHEN 'i'  THEN 'Iodine'
    WHEN 'sn' THEN 'Tin'
    WHEN 'pb' THEN 'Lead'
    WHEN 'te' THEN 'Tellurium'
    WHEN 'ca' THEN 'Calcium'
    ELSE a.element
  END AS element
FROM atom a
WHERE a.atom_id IN (
    SELECT atom_id  FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
    UNION
    SELECT atom_id2 FROM connected WHERE bond_id = 'TR001_2_4'
);

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cons AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM czk)
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t.total) AS min_total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, t.total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN seg_min m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_increase
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct_increase
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND (
      percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))
      OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))

WITH czk_2013 AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, y.CustomerID, y.Consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'CZK'
      AND y.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
),
min_cons AS (
    SELECT Segment, MIN(Consumption) AS min_c
    FROM czk_2013
    GROUP BY Segment
),
seg_avg AS (
    SELECT z.Segment, SUM(z.Consumption) / COUNT(z.CustomerID) AS avg_cons
    FROM czk_2013 z
    JOIN min_cons m ON z.Segment = m.Segment AND z.Consumption = m.min_c
    GROUP BY z.Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') - (SELECT avg_cons FROM seg_avg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH pct AS (
    SELECT c.Segment AS Segment,
           (SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)
          - SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2012' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
          / SUM(CASE WHEN SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) = '2013' THEN ym.Consumption ELSE 0 END) AS Percentage
    FROM yearmonth ym
    JOIN customers c ON ym.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND c.Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
      AND SUBSTR(ym.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment
)
SELECT Segment, Percentage
FROM pct
WHERE Percentage = (SELECT MAX(Percentage) FROM pct)
   OR Percentage = (SELECT MIN(Percentage) FROM pct);

    FROM schools
),

    FROM admin_names

JOIN Team t ON ta.team_api_id = t.team_api_id
WHERE ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass = 'Slow';

SELECT DISTINCT T.team_short_name
FROM Team T
JOIN Team_Attributes TA ON T.team_api_id = TA.team_api_id
WHERE TA.chanceCreationPassingClass = 'Safe';

SELECT AVG(DISTINCT p.height) AS avg_height
FROM Match m
JOIN Country c ON c.id = m.country_id
JOIN Player p ON p.player_api_id IN (
    m.home_player_1, m.home_player_2, m.home_player_3, m.home_player_4, m.home_player_5,
    m.home_player_6, m.home_player_7, m.home_player_8, m.home_player_9, m.home_player_10, m.home_player_11,
    m.away_player_1, m.away_player_2, m.away_player_3, m.away_player_4, m.away_player_5,
    m.away_player_6, m.away_player_7, m.away_player_8, m.away_player_9, m.away_player_10, m.away_player_11
)
WHERE c.name = 'Italy';
SELECT player_name FROM Player WHERE height > 180 ORDER BY player_name ASC LIMIT 3;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Player WHERE player_name LIKE 'Aaron%' AND birthday > '1990';

SELECT pa1.jumping - pa2.jumping AS difference
FROM Player_Attributes pa1
JOIN Player_Attributes pa2 ON pa1.id <> pa2.id
WHERE pa1.id = 6 AND pa2.id = 23;

SELECT pa.player_api_id
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE pa.preferred_foot = 'right'
GROUP BY pa.player_api_id
ORDER BY MIN(pa.potential) ASC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.player_api_id)
FROM Player AS P
INNER JOIN Player_Attributes AS PA
    ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
INNER JOIN (
    SELECT MAX(crossing) AS max_crossing
    FROM Player_Attributes
) AS M
    ON PA.crossing = M.max_crossing
WHERE PA.preferred_foot = 'left';
SELECT Country.name FROM League JOIN Country ON League.country_id = Country.id WHERE League.name = 'Poland Ekstraklasa';

SELECT T1.team_long_name AS home_team, T2.team_long_name AS away_team, M.home_team_goal, M.away_team_goal
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
JOIN Team T1 ON M.home_team_api_id = T1.team_api_id
JOIN Team T2 ON M.away_team_api_id = T2.team_api_id
WHERE M.date LIKE '2008-09-24%' AND L.name = 'Belgium Jupiler League';

SELECT pa.sprint_speed, pa.agility, pa.acceleration
FROM Player p
JOIN Player_Attributes pa ON p.player_api_id = pa.player_api_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'Alexis Blin';

SELECT ta.buildUpPlaySpeedClass
FROM Team t
JOIN Team_Attributes ta ON t.team_api_id = ta.team_api_id
WHERE t.team_long_name = 'KSV Cercle Brugge';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS game_count
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.league_id = l.id
JOIN Country c ON l.country_id = c.id
WHERE m.season = '2015/2016'
  AND c.name = 'Italy'
  AND l.name LIKE '%Serie A%';

SELECT MAX(M.home_team_goal) AS highest_home_score
FROM Match M
JOIN League L ON M.league_id = L.id
WHERE L.name = 'Netherlands Eredivisie';

SELECT pa.finishing, pa.curve
FROM Player_Attributes pa
JOIN Player p ON pa.player_api_id = p.player_api_id
WHERE p.weight = (SELECT MAX(weight) FROM Player);

SELECT L.name AS league_name, COUNT(M.id) AS games
FROM League L
JOIN Match M ON L.id = M.league_id
WHERE M.season = '2015/2016'
GROUP BY L.name
ORDER BY games DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT T.team_long_name
FROM Match AS M
JOIN Team AS T ON M.away_team_api_id = T.team_api_id
WHERE M.away_team_goal = (SELECT MAX(away_team_goal) FROM Match)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.player_name
FROM Player P
JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.player_api_id = PA.player_api_id
WHERE PA.overall_rating = (SELECT MAX(overall_rating) FROM Player_Attributes)
LIMIT 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) AS num_accounts
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id)
FROM account a

JOIN loan l ON a.account_id = l.account_id

         WHEN AVG(A12) > AVG(A13) THEN '1995'
         ELSE '1996'

FROM district;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.district_id) AS num_districts
FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND d.A11 > 6000
  AND d.A11 < 10000;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'M'

SELECT dp.account_id,
       (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district) - di.A11 AS gap
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
JOIN district di ON di.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
  AND c.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F')
  AND di.A11 = (SELECT MIN(d2.A11)
                FROM client c2
                JOIN district d2 ON d2.district_id = c2.district_id
                WHERE c2.gender = 'F'
                  AND c2.birth_date = (SELECT MIN(birth_date) FROM client WHERE gender = 'F'));

SELECT DISTINCT a.account_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp dp ON c.client_id = dp.client_id
JOIN account a ON dp.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON c.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE c.birth_date = (SELECT MAX(birth_date) FROM client)
  AND d.A11 = (SELECT MAX(A11) FROM district);

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT d.client_id) AS num_customers
FROM disp d
JOIN account a ON d.account_id = a.account_id

SELECT c.client_id
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON d.client_id = c.client_id

SELECT d.disp_id

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'Prague'

LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN c.gender = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS male_percentage
FROM client c
JOIN district d ON d.district_id = c.district_id
WHERE d.A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) = (
      SELECT MAX(CAST(A4 AS INTEGER))
      FROM district
      WHERE A3 = 'south Bohemia'
  );

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_early AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_late AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ((SELECT balance FROM bal_late) - (SELECT balance FROM bal_early)) * 100.0
    / (SELECT balance FROM bal_early) AS increase_rate;
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'A' THEN amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(amount) AS percentage FROM loan;

FROM account a
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
WHERE a.frequency = 'POPLATEK PO OBRATU'

WHERE disp.type = 'OWNER'

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

FROM loan l
JOIN account a ON l.account_id = a.account_id

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

FROM district d
JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id
WHERE c.gender = 'F'
GROUP BY d.A2

JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id

SELECT m.first_name, m.last_name
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
JOIN budget b ON b.budget_id = e.link_to_budget
WHERE m.member_id IN (
    SELECT e2.link_to_member
    FROM expense e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2.budget_id = e2.link_to_budget
    GROUP BY e2.link_to_member
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b2.link_to_event) > 1
)
ORDER BY e.cost DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(e.cost) / COUNT(ev.event_id) AS average_amount_paid
FROM expense e
JOIN member m ON e.link_to_member = m.member_id
JOIN budget b ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
JOIN event ev ON b.link_to_event = ev.event_id
WHERE m.position != 'Member';

SELECT e.event_name
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.link_to_event = e.event_id
JOIN expense x ON x.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
WHERE b.category = 'Parking'
GROUP BY e.event_id, e.event_name
HAVING SUM(x.cost) < (
    SELECT SUM(x2.cost) / COUNT(e2.event_id)
    FROM event e2
    JOIN budget b2 ON b2.link_to_event = e2.event_id
    JOIN expense x2 ON x2.link_to_budget = b2.budget_id
    WHERE b2.category = 'Parking'
);

JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_female_count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 1 AND gender.id = 2;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE c.colour = 'blue' AND g.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON gender.id = superhero.gender_id
JOIN alignment ON alignment.id = superhero.alignment_id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 0 OR superhero.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower s ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY T1.superhero_name ASC

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_heroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
JOIN superhero ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT ha.hero_id
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(s2.height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero s2
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') >
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') AS more_inpatients,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') AS REAL) /
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') AS deviation_percentage

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, (year(current_timestamp) - year(Patient.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT COUNT(p.ID) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND (l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.5);

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1997' AND Patient.Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(YEAR(`First Date`) - YEAR(Birthday)) FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."Thrombosis" = '1'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', E."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) = 1997
  AND P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.Birthday = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.Birthday)
      FROM Patient AS T3
      JOIN Examination AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT L.`Date`, YEAR(P.`First Date`) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE YEAR(T2.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(T1.`First Date`) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) < 18
  AND YEAR(e.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT YEAR(e.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(p.`Birthday`) AS age, p.`Diagnosis`
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = l.ID
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT E.ANA FROM Examination AS E WHERE E.ID = 3605340 AND E.`Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-9-4'
  AND "T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY "First Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT `aCL IgM`
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
      AND Description = '1994-02-19'
  );

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', l.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT p.`Diagnosis`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND e.[Examination Date] = '1993-09-27';

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
        AND `Examination Date` < '1998-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND T2.GPT > 30
  AND T2.ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(T1.Birthday) = 1964
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.T-BIL < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."ANA Pattern" != 'P'
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.BIRTHDAY) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(l.ALB)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.PLT > 400
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE YEAR(T1.Date) = '1997' AND (T1.TP <= 6 OR T1.TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(e.`Examination Date`), p.`First Date`) AS evaluation_delay
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.ID = 57266
  AND ((L.UA > 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M') OR (L.UA > 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F'));
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = 1994 AND l.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 60
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS `ALP within normal range`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Description, p."First Date", p.Admission, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1982;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS result
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.`T-BIL`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(YEAR(NOW()) - YEAR(P.Birthday)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250) H
  ON P.ID = H.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.TG AS REAL) > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-' AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(p.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GLU >= 180 AND l.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.GLU
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE year(Patient.Description) = 1991 AND Laboratory.GLU < 180;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.WBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.WBC >= 9.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX, Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday
ORDER BY Patient.SEX ASC, Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       P.Diagnosis,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.RBC < 3.5
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - STRFTIME('%Y', P.Birthday) > 55;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(strftime('%Y', P.`First Date`) AS INTEGER) > 1992
  AND L.PT < 14;

SELECT COUNT(*) 
FROM Examination AS E 
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON E.ID = L.ID 
WHERE E.`Examination Date` > '1997-01-01' AND L.APTT < 45;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Laboratory l ON e.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.APTT > 45
  AND e.Thrombosis = 0;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.WBC > 3.5 AND T2.WBC < 9.0 AND (T2.FG <= 150 OR T2.FG >= 450)

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID)
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday > '1980-01-01'
  AND (l.FG < 150 OR l.FG > 450);
SELECT DISTINCT T1.Diagnosis FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T2.`U-PRO` >= 30;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID

WITH czk AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, Segment
    FROM customers
    WHERE Currency = 'CZK'
),
cons AS (
    SELECT ym.CustomerID, SUM(ym.Consumption) AS total
    FROM yearmonth ym
    WHERE ym.Date BETWEEN 201301 AND 201312
      AND ym.CustomerID IN (SELECT CustomerID FROM czk)
    GROUP BY ym.CustomerID
),
seg_min AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, MIN(t.total) AS min_total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    GROUP BY c.Segment
),
lowest AS (
    SELECT c.Segment, t.total
    FROM cons t
    JOIN czk c ON t.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    JOIN seg_min m ON c.Segment = m.Segment AND t.total = m.min_total
),
avg_seg AS (
    SELECT Segment, SUM(total) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS annual_avg
    FROM lowest
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM') AS diff_SME_LAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'LAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM') AS diff_LAM_KAM,
    (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'KAM')
      - (SELECT annual_avg FROM avg_seg WHERE Segment = 'SME') AS diff_KAM_SME;

WITH eur_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c.Segment,
        SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) AS yr,
        SUM(y.Consumption) AS total_consumption
    FROM yearmonth y
    JOIN customers c
        ON y.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
    WHERE c.Currency = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY c.Segment, SUBSTR(y.Date, 1, 4)
),
pct_increase AS (
    SELECT
        Segment,
        (SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)
         - SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2012' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0
         / SUM(CASE WHEN yr = '2013' THEN total_consumption ELSE 0 END) AS percentage_increase
    FROM eur_consumption
    GROUP BY Segment
)
SELECT Segment, percentage_increase
FROM pct_increase
WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
  AND (
      percentage_increase = (SELECT MAX(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))
      OR percentage_increase = (SELECT MIN(percentage_increase) FROM pct_increase WHERE Segment IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM'))
  );

WITH target_loan AS (
    SELECT account_id
    FROM loan
    WHERE date = '1993-07-05'
    ORDER BY loan_id
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_early AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1993-03-22'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
bal_late AS (
    SELECT balance
    FROM trans
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM target_loan)
      AND date = '1998-12-27'
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    ((SELECT balance FROM bal_late) - (SELECT balance FROM bal_early)) * 100.0
    / (SELECT balance FROM bal_early) AS increase_rate;

JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.power_id
JOIN superhero AS T3 ON T2.hero_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.full_name = 'Helen Parr';

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE s.weight_kg = 108
  AND s.height_cm = 188;

SELECT publisher.publisher_name
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id
WHERE superhero.id = 38;

SELECT race.race
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN superhero ON hero_attribute.hero_id = superhero.id
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
ORDER BY hero_attribute.attribute_value DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT a.alignment, sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Atom IV';

SELECT superhero.full_name
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE colour.colour = 'Blue'
LIMIT 5;

SELECT AVG(ha.attribute_value) AS average_attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE s.alignment_id = 3;

SELECT DISTINCT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
JOIN colour c ON s.skin_colour_id = c.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS good_female_count
FROM superhero
JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id
JOIN gender ON superhero.gender_id = gender.id
WHERE alignment.id = 1 AND gender.id = 2;

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
WHERE ha.attribute_value BETWEEN 75 AND 80;

SELECT r.race
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.hair_colour_id = c.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
WHERE c.colour = 'blue' AND g.gender = 'male';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN gender.id = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage
FROM superhero
JOIN gender ON gender.id = superhero.gender_id
JOIN alignment ON alignment.id = superhero.alignment_id
WHERE alignment.id = 2;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN colour.id = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero
JOIN colour ON superhero.eye_colour_id = colour.id
WHERE superhero.weight_kg = 0 OR superhero.weight_kg IS NULL;

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Hulk'
  AND a.attribute_name = 'Strength';

SELECT s.power_name
FROM superhero sh
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = sh.id
JOIN superpower s ON s.id = hp.power_id
WHERE sh.superhero_name = 'Ajax';

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero JOIN colour ON superhero.skin_colour_id = colour.id JOIN alignment ON superhero.alignment_id = alignment.id WHERE colour.colour = 'Green' AND alignment.alignment = 'Bad';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id WHERE g.gender = 'Female' AND p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT T1.superhero_name
FROM superhero AS T1
JOIN hero_power AS T2 ON T1.id = T2.hero_id
JOIN superpower AS T3 ON T2.power_id = T3.id
WHERE T3.power_name = 'Wind Control'
ORDER BY T1.superhero_name ASC

SELECT g.gender
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Phoenix Force';

SELECT s.superhero_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics'
ORDER BY s.weight_kg DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN race r ON s.race_id = r.id
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE r.race <> 'Human'
  AND p.publisher_name = 'Dark Horse Comics';

SELECT COUNT(*) AS fastest_heroes
FROM hero_attribute
JOIN attribute ON attribute.id = hero_attribute.attribute_id
JOIN superhero ON superhero.id = hero_attribute.hero_id
WHERE attribute.attribute_name = 'Speed'
  AND hero_attribute.attribute_value = 100;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
WHERE p.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');

SELECT a.attribute_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id
JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Black Panther'
ORDER BY ha.attribute_value ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Abomination';
SELECT superhero_name FROM superhero WHERE full_name = 'Charles Chandler';

SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage_female
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN gender g ON s.gender_id = g.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'George Lucas';

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN a.alignment = 'Good' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_good
FROM superhero s
JOIN publisher p ON s.publisher_id = p.id
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';

SELECT ha.hero_id
FROM hero_attribute ha
JOIN superhero s ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE ha.attribute_value = (SELECT MIN(attribute_value) FROM hero_attribute);

SELECT s.full_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.weight_kg < 100
  AND c.colour = 'Brown';

SELECT ha.attribute_value
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.id = ha.hero_id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Aquababy';

SELECT superhero.weight_kg, race.race
FROM superhero
JOIN race ON superhero.race_id = race.id
WHERE superhero.id = 40;

SELECT AVG(s.height_cm) AS average_height
FROM superhero s
JOIN alignment a ON s.alignment_id = a.id
WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT hp.hero_id
FROM hero_power hp
JOIN superpower sp ON hp.power_id = sp.id
WHERE sp.power_name = 'Intelligence';

SELECT c.colour
FROM superhero s
JOIN colour c ON s.eye_colour_id = c.id
WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Blackwulf';

SELECT DISTINCT sp.power_name
FROM superhero s
JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id
JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id
WHERE s.height_cm > (
    SELECT AVG(s2.height_cm) * 0.8
    FROM superhero s2
);

SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') >
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') AS more_inpatients,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '+') AS REAL) /
  (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'M' AND Admission = '-') AS deviation_percentage

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN T1.Admission = '+' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*) AS percentage_inpatient
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Birthday BETWEEN '1930-01-01' AND '1940-12-31';

SELECT p.Diagnosis, l.Date
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.ID = '30609';

SELECT p.SEX, p.Birthday, e.`Examination Date`, e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.ID = '163109';

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.LDH > 500;

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, (year(current_timestamp) - year(Patient.Birthday)) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Examination ON Patient.ID = Examination.ID
WHERE Examination.RVVT = '+';

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.Thrombosis = 2;
SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) = '1937' AND T2.`T-CHO` >= 250

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.ALB < 3.5;

SELECT COUNT(p.ID) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(ID) FROM Patient WHERE SEX = 'F')
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F' AND (l.TP < 6.0 OR l.TP > 8.5);

SELECT AVG(T2.`aCL IgG`) AS avg_aCL_IgG
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '+'
  AND (strftime('%Y', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday)) >= 50;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Patient WHERE Patient.SEX = 'F' AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Description) = '1997' AND Patient.Admission = '-'
SELECT MIN(YEAR(`First Date`) - YEAR(Birthday)) FROM Patient;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."Thrombosis" = '1'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', E."Examination Date") AS INTEGER) = 1997
  AND P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT MAX(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER))
     - MIN(CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', T1.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS age_gap
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.TG >= 200;

SELECT T1.Symptoms, T1.Diagnosis
FROM Examination AS T1
JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Symptoms IS NOT NULL
  AND T2.Birthday = (
      SELECT MAX(T3.Birthday)
      FROM Patient AS T3
      JOIN Examination AS T4 ON T3.ID = T4.ID
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) / 12
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1998-01-01' AND '1998-12-31';

SELECT L.`Date`, YEAR(P.`First Date`) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS Age_at_First_Visit
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis LIKE '%SJS%'
ORDER BY P.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' AND l.UA <= 8.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) /
       SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' AND l.UA <= 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS male_to_female_ratio
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE YEAR(T2.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(T1.`First Date`) >= 1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID)
FROM Examination e
JOIN Patient p ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE YEAR(p.Birthday) < 18
  AND YEAR(e.`Examination Date`) BETWEEN 1990 AND 1993;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M' AND Laboratory.`T-BIL` >= 2.0;

SELECT T1.Diagnosis
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1985-01-01' AND '1995-12-31'
GROUP BY T1.Diagnosis
ORDER BY COUNT(T1.Diagnosis) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age
FROM Laboratory
JOIN Patient ON Laboratory.ID = Patient.ID
WHERE Laboratory.Date BETWEEN '1991-10-01' AND '1991-10-30';

SELECT YEAR(e.`Examination Date`) - YEAR(p.`Birthday`) AS age, p.`Diagnosis`
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = l.ID
JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.HGB = (SELECT MAX(HGB) FROM Laboratory);
SELECT E.ANA FROM Examination AS E WHERE E.ID = 3605340 AND E.`Examination Date` = '1996-12-02'

SELECT COUNT(*) > 0
FROM Laboratory
WHERE ID = 2927464
  AND Date = '1995-9-4'
  AND "T-CHO" < 250;

SELECT SEX
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis = 'AORTITIS'
ORDER BY "First Date" ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT `aCL IgM`
FROM Examination
WHERE `Examination Date` = '1993-11-12'
  AND ID IN (
    SELECT ID
    FROM Patient
    WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
      AND Description = '1994-02-19'
  );

SELECT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.GPT = '9' AND L.Date = '1992-06-12';

SELECT STRFTIME('%Y', l.Date) - STRFTIME('%Y', p.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.UA = '8.4' AND l.Date = '1991-10-21';

SELECT COUNT(T2.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.`First Date` = '1991-06-13'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'SJS'
  AND T2.Date BETWEEN '1995-01-01' AND '1995-12-31';

SELECT p.`Diagnosis`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE e.`Examination Date` = '1997-01-27'
  AND e.`Diagnosis` = 'SLE';

SELECT e.Symptoms
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.ID = e.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1959-03-01'
  AND e.[Examination Date] = '1993-09-27';

SELECT DISTINCT ID
FROM Patient
WHERE Diagnosis LIKE '%Behcet%'
  AND ID IN (
      SELECT ID
      FROM Examination
      WHERE `Examination Date` >= '1997-01-01'
        AND `Examination Date` < '1998-01-01'
  );

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Date BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
  AND T2.GPT > 30
  AND T2.ALB < 4;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
WHERE T1.SEX = 'F'
  AND YEAR(T1.Birthday) = 1964
  AND T1.Admission = '+';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
INNER JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.Thrombosis = 2
  AND T2.ANA = 'S'
  AND T2.`aCL IgM` > (SELECT AVG(`aCL IgM`) FROM Examination) * 1.2;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-'
  AND L.Date LIKE '1991-10%'
  AND L.T-BIL < 2.0;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Examination AS E ON P.ID = E.ID
WHERE E."ANA Pattern" != 'P'
  AND P.SEX = 'F'
  AND CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', P.BIRTHDAY) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;

SELECT DISTINCT P.SEX
FROM Patient P
JOIN Examination E ON P.ID = E.ID
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE E.Diagnosis = 'PSS'
  AND L.CRP > 2
  AND L.CRE = 1
  AND L.LDH = 123;

SELECT AVG(l.ALB)
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'F'
  AND l.PLT > 400
  AND p.Diagnosis = 'SLE';

SELECT Symptoms
FROM Examination
WHERE Diagnosis = 'SLE'
GROUP BY Symptoms
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Laboratory AS T1 WHERE YEAR(T1.Date) = '1997' AND (T1.TP <= 6 OR T1.TP >= 8.5);

SELECT SUM(SEX = 'F') / COUNT(SEX) * 100 AS percentage_women
FROM Patient
WHERE YEAR(Birthday) = '1980'
  AND Diagnosis = 'RA';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID)
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Examination AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.SEX = 'M'
  AND T2.`Examination Date` BETWEEN '1995' AND '1997'
  AND T1.Diagnosis = 'Behcet'
  AND T1.Admission = '-';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT P.ID)
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.WBC < 3.5;

SELECT DATEDIFF(MIN(e.`Examination Date`), p.`First Date`) AS evaluation_delay
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON e.ID = p.ID
WHERE p.ID = 821298;

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM Laboratory AS L
JOIN Patient AS P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE L.ID = 57266
  AND ((L.UA > 8.0 AND P.SEX = 'M') OR (L.UA > 6.5 AND P.SEX = 'F'));
SELECT Date FROM Laboratory WHERE ID = '48473' AND GOT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE YEAR(l.Date) = 1994 AND l.GOT < 60;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M'
  AND L.GPT >= 60;

SELECT DISTINCT p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GPT > 60
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC;
SELECT AVG(LDH) FROM Laboratory WHERE LDH < 500

SELECT DISTINCT Patient.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(Patient.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.LDH BETWEEN 600 AND 800;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.Admission
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T2.ALP < 300;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALP < 300 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS `ALP within normal range`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.Birthday = '1982-04-01';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.TP < 6.0;

SELECT L.TP - 8.5 AS deviation
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F' AND L.TP > 8.5;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, p.Description, p."First Date", p.Admission, p.Diagnosis
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE p.SEX = 'M'
  AND (l.ALB <= 3.5 OR l.ALB >= 5.5)
ORDER BY p.Birthday DESC;

SELECT p.ID,
       CASE WHEN l.ALB BETWEEN 3.5 AND 5.5 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS Albumin_Normal_Range
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(p.Birthday, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) = 1982;

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN L.UA > 6.5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F';

SELECT AVG(T1.UA)
FROM Laboratory AS T1
INNER JOIN Patient AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Date = (SELECT MAX(T3.Date) FROM Laboratory AS T3 WHERE T3.ID = T1.ID)
  AND ((T2.SEX = 'M' AND T1.UA < 8.0) OR (T2.SEX = 'F' AND T1.UA < 6.5));

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.UN = 29;

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.SEX, P.Birthday
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.Diagnosis = 'RA'
  AND L.UN < 30;
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT T1.ID) FROM Patient AS T1 JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID WHERE T1.SEX = 'M' AND T2.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'M' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > SUM(CASE WHEN p.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)) AS result
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.CRE >= 1.5;

SELECT p.ID, p.SEX, p.Birthday, l.`T-BIL`
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` = (SELECT MAX(`T-BIL`) FROM Laboratory);

SELECT p.SEX, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS Patients
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.`T-BIL` >= 2.0
GROUP BY p.SEX;

SELECT l.ID, l.`T-CHO`
FROM Laboratory l
JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
WHERE l.`T-CHO` = (SELECT MAX(`T-CHO`) FROM Laboratory)
ORDER BY p.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT SUM(YEAR(NOW()) - YEAR(P.Birthday)) / COUNT(P.ID) AS average_age
FROM Patient P
JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT ID FROM Laboratory WHERE `T-CHO` >= 250) H
  ON P.ID = H.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'M';

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Diagnosis
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE CAST(L.TG AS REAL) > 300;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.TG >= 200
  AND SUBTRACT(YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), YEAR(Patient.Birthday)) > 50;

SELECT DISTINCT L.ID
FROM Laboratory L
JOIN Patient P ON L.ID = P.ID
WHERE P.Admission = '-' AND L.CPK < 250;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT Patient.ID)
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Patient.SEX = 'M'
  AND strftime('%Y', Patient.Birthday) BETWEEN '1936' AND '1956'
  AND Laboratory.CPK >= 250;

SELECT DISTINCT p.ID, p.SEX, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(p.Birthday) AS Age
FROM Patient p
JOIN Laboratory l ON p.ID = l.ID
WHERE l.GLU >= 180 AND l.`T-CHO` < 250;

SELECT Patient.ID, Laboratory.GLU
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE year(Patient.Description) = 1991 AND Laboratory.GLU < 180;

SELECT Patient.ID, Patient.SEX, Patient.Birthday
FROM Patient
JOIN Laboratory ON Patient.ID = Laboratory.ID
WHERE Laboratory.WBC <= 3.5 OR Laboratory.WBC >= 9.0
GROUP BY Patient.SEX, Patient.ID, Patient.Birthday
ORDER BY Patient.SEX ASC, Patient.Birthday DESC;

SELECT P.ID,
       P.Diagnosis,
       strftime('%Y', current_timestamp) - strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient AS P
WHERE P.ID IN (
    SELECT L.ID
    FROM Laboratory AS L
    WHERE L.RBC < 3.5
);

SELECT DISTINCT P.ID, P.Admission
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE P.SEX = 'F'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', 'now') AS INTEGER) - CAST(strftime('%Y', P.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) >= 50
  AND (L.RBC <= 3.5 OR L.RBC >= 6.0);

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Admission = '-' AND T2.HGB < 10;

SELECT T1.ID, T1.SEX
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE T1.Diagnosis = 'SLE'
  AND T2.HGB > 10
  AND T2.HGB < 17
ORDER BY T1.Birthday ASC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT P.ID, YEAR(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) - YEAR(P.Birthday) AS age
FROM Patient P
JOIN Laboratory L ON P.ID = L.ID
WHERE L.HCT >= 52
GROUP BY P.ID, P.Birthday
HAVING COUNT(L.ID) > 2;
SELECT AVG(HCT) FROM Laboratory WHERE Date LIKE '1991%' AND HCT < 29;

SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) AS lower_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS higher_than_normal,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT < 100 THEN ID END) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN PLT > 400 THEN ID END) AS difference
FROM Laboratory
WHERE PLT <= 100 OR PLT >= 400;

SELECT DISTINCT T1.ID
FROM Patient AS T1
JOIN Laboratory AS T2 ON T1.ID = T2.ID
WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', T2.Date) = '1984'
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', 'now') - STRFTIME('%Y', T1.Birthday) < 50
  AND T2.PLT BETWEEN 100 AND 400;

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 AND P.SEX = 'F' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0
       / SUM(CASE WHEN L.PT >= 14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS percentage
FROM Patient AS P
JOIN Laboratory AS L ON P.ID = L.ID
